sentences.zh: 盛應期，字思徵，吳江人。

translations.literal: Sheng Yingqi, styled Sizheng, was a man of Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yingqi, styled Sizheng, was a native of Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Hongzhi reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授都水主事，出轄濟寧諸閘。

translations.literal: He was appointed a principal officer in the Directorate of Waterways and went out to oversee the locks around Jining.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal officer in the Directorate of Waterways and sent out to supervise the locks around Jining.

sentences.zh: 太監李廣家人市私鹽至濟，畏應期，投鹽水中去。

translations.literal: The eunuch Li Guang's household servants came to Jining to sell illicit salt; fearing Yingqi, they threw the salt into the water and left.
translations.idiomatic: When the eunuch Li Guang's household servants came to Jining to sell illicit salt, they feared Yingqi and threw the salt into the water before fleeing.

sentences.zh: 會南京進貢內官誣應期阻薦新船，廣從中構逮應期及主事範璋下詔獄。

translations.literal: Meanwhile a Nanjing palace eunuch sent to deliver tribute falsely accused Yingqi of obstructing the recommendation of new boats; Guang contrived from within to have Yingqi and the principal officer Fan Zhang arrested and sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile a palace eunuch from Nanjing delivering tribute falsely accused Yingqi of blocking the recommendation of new grain boats, and Guang engineered from within to have Yingqi and the principal officer Fan Zhang arrested and sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 璋筦衛河，亦忤中貴者也。

translations.literal: Zhang had charge of the Wei River transport canal and had likewise offended the inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang had charge of the Wei River canal and had likewise offended the palace eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 獄具，謫雲南驛丞。

translations.literal: When the case was concluded, he was demoted to assistant at a Yun_nan courier station.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was concluded, he was demoted to assistant at a courier station in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 稍遷祿豐知縣。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred to be magistrate of Lufeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to magistrate of Lufeng.

sentences.zh: 正德初，歷雲南僉事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengde he served as assistant commissioner in Yun_nan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhengde reign he served as assistant commissioner in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 武定知府鳳應死，其妻攝府事，子朝鳴為寇。

translations.literal: When Feng Ying, prefect of Wuding, died, his wife took charge of the prefecture and their son Chaoming became a bandit.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Ying, the prefect of Wuding, died, his wife took charge of the prefecture while their son Chaoming turned to banditry.

sentences.zh: 應期單車入其境，母子惶怖，歸所侵。

translations.literal: Yingqi entered their territory alone in a single cart; mother and son were filled with dread and returned what they had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi drove alone into their territory; mother and son were terrified and returned what they had seized.

sentences.zh: 策鳳氏終亂，奏降其秩，設官制之。

translations.literal: He judged that the Feng clan would eventually rebel and memorialized to reduce their rank and set up officials to control them.
translations.idiomatic: Judging that the Feng clan would eventually rebel, he memorialized to reduce their rank and place them under regular official control.

sentences.zh: 寢不行，後卒叛。

translations.literal: The proposal lay dormant and was not implemented; they later did rebel.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was shelved and never carried out; they rebelled in the end.

sentences.zh: 與御史張璞、副使晁必登抑鎮守太監梁裕。

translations.literal: Together with the censor Zhang Pu and the vice commissioner Chao Bideng, he curbed the resident eunuch Liang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the censor Zhang Pu and the vice commissioner Chao Bideng, he reined in the resident eunuch Liang Yu.

sentences.zh: 裕劾三人，俱逮下詔獄，璞竟拷死。

translations.literal: Yu impeached all three; they were arrested and sent to the imperial prison, and Pu was tortured to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yu impeached all three men; they were arrested and sent to the imperial prison, and Pu was tortured to death.

sentences.zh: 會乾清宮災，應期得復職，四遷至陜西右布政使。

translations.literal: When the Qianqing Palace burned, Yingqi was restored to office and was promoted four times to become right administration commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qianqing Palace burned, Yingqi was restored to office and rose through four promotions to right administration commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 擢右副都御史，巡撫四川。

translations.literal: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 討平天全六番招討使高文林。

translations.literal: He suppressed and pacified Gao Wenlin, pacification commissioner of the six Tianshan fan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He suppressed Gao Wenlin, pacification commissioner of the six Tianshan fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 會泉江僰蠻普法惡作亂，富順奸民謝文禮、文義附之。

translations.literal: When the Bo barbarian Pufa'e of Quanjiang rebelled, the Fushun ruffians Xie Wenli and Wenyi joined him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Bo chieftain Pufa'e of Quanjiang rebelled, the Fushun ruffians Xie Wenli and Wenyi joined him.

sentences.zh: 法惡死，指揮何卿等先後討誅文禮、文義。

translations.literal: When Pufa'e died, the commanders He Qing and others successively campaigned against and executed Wenli and Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: After Pufa'e died, the commanders He Qing and others in turn campaigned against and executed Wenli and Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 應期賚銀幣，以憂歸。

translations.literal: Yingqi was rewarded with silver and silks and returned home on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi was rewarded with silver and silks, then went home on mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年，起故官，巡撫江西。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing he was recalled to his former post as grand coordinator of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiajing he was recalled to his former rank and appointed grand coordinator of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 宸濠亂後，瘡痍未復，奏免雜調緡錢數十萬，請留轉輸南京米四十七萬，銀二十萬，以食饑民。

translations.literal: After the Prince of Ning rebellion the wounds had not healed; he memorialized to remit several hundred thousand strings in miscellaneous levies and asked to retain 470,000 piculs of Nanjing grain in transit and 200,000 taels of silver to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: After the Prince of Ning rebellion the province had not recovered; he memorialized to remit several hundred thousand strings in miscellaneous levies and asked to retain 470,000 piculs of grain being shipped from Nanjing and 200,000 taels of silver to feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 又令諸府積谷備荒至百余萬。

translations.literal: He also ordered the prefectures to store grain against famine until the total exceeded one million piculs.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the prefectures to build famine reserves until the total exceeded one million piculs.

sentences.zh: 尋進兵部右侍郎，總督兩廣軍務。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to right vice minister of War and made supreme commander of military affairs in the two Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to right vice minister of War and made supreme commander of military affairs in Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 將行，籍上積谷數。

translations.literal: As he was about to depart, he registered and reported the amount of stored grain.
translations.idiomatic: Before he departed, he registered and reported the amount of stored grain.

sentences.zh: 帝以陳洪謨代，而獎賚應期。

translations.literal: The emperor replaced him with Chen Hongmo but rewarded Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replaced him with Chen Hongmo but rewarded Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 後洪謨積益多，亦被賚。

translations.literal: Later Hongmo accumulated even more and was also rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hongmo accumulated even more grain and was rewarded as well.

sentences.zh: 應期至廣，偕撫寧侯朱麒督參將李璋等，討平思恩土目劉召，復賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When Yingqi reached Guang, together with the Marquis of Funing Zhu Qi he directed the regional commander Li Zhang and others to suppress the Sinan native official Liu Zhao and was again rewarded with silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingqi reached Guangdong, he joined the Marquis of Funing Zhu Qi in directing Regional Commander Li Zhang and others to suppress the Sinan native chieftain Liu Zhao and was again rewarded with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 朝議大征岑猛。

translations.literal: The court debated a major campaign against Cen Meng.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated launching a major campaign against Cen Meng.

sentences.zh: 應期條上方略七事，言廣兵疲弱不可用。

translations.literal: Yingqi submitted seven items of strategy and said the Guang troops were weak and exhausted and could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi submitted a seven-point strategy and argued that the Guang troops were weak and exhausted and unfit for service.

sentences.zh: 麒等恚。

translations.literal: Qi and the others were resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Qi and his allies were furious.

sentences.zh: 會御史許中劾應期暴虐，麒等因相與為流言。

translations.literal: When the censor Xu Zhong impeached Yingqi for cruelty, Qi and the others together spread rumors.
translations.idiomatic: When the censor Xu Zhong impeached Yingqi for cruelty, Qi and his allies spread rumors together.

sentences.zh: 御史鄭洛書復劾應期賄結權貴。

translations.literal: The censor Zheng Luoshu again impeached Yingqi for bribing powerful men.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Zheng Luoshu again impeached Yingqi for bribing powerful officials.

sentences.zh: 應期已遷工部侍郎，引疾歸。

translations.literal: Yingqi had already been transferred to vice minister of Works and retired on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi had already been transferred to vice minister of Works and retired citing illness.

sentences.zh: 六年，黃河水溢入漕渠，沛北廟道口淤數十里，糧艘為阻，侍郎章拯不能治。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Yellow River overflowed into the grain transport canal; north of Pei the Miaodao mouth silted for several tens of li and grain boats were blocked, and Vice Minister Zhang Zheng could not remedy it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Yellow River overflowed into the grain transport canal; north of Pei the Miaodao mouth silted up for dozens of li and grain boats were blocked, and Vice Minister Zhang Zheng could not fix it.

sentences.zh: 尚書胡世寧、詹事霍韜、僉事江良材請於昭陽湖東別開漕渠，為經久計。

translations.literal: The ministers Hu Shining and Huo Tao and the assistant commissioner Jiang Liangcai asked to open a separate grain canal east of Zhaoyang Lake as a long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Hu Shining, Grand Mentor Huo Tao, and Assistant Commissioner Jiang Liangcai proposed opening a separate grain canal east of Zhaoyang Lake as a lasting solution.

sentences.zh: 議未定，以御史吳仲言召拯還，即家拜應期右都御史以往。

translations.literal: Before the plan was settled, on the censor Wu Zhong's recommendation Zhang was recalled and Yingqi was appointed right censor-in-chief at his home to go there.
translations.idiomatic: Before the plan was settled, on Censor Wu Zhong's recommendation Zhang was recalled and Yingqi was appointed right censor-in-chief from his home to take charge.

sentences.zh: 應期乃議於昭陽湖東，北進江家口，南出留城口，開浚百四十餘里，較疏舊河力省而利永。

translations.literal: Yingqi then proposed east of Zhaoyang Lake to advance north from Jiangjiakou and exit south at Liuchengkou, dredging more than 140 li—less labor than dredging the old river and more lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi then proposed a route east of Zhaoyang Lake, entering north at Jiangjiakou and exiting south at Liuchengkou, dredging more than 140 li—less labor than clearing the old river and more lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 夫六萬五千，銀二十萬兩，克期六月。

translations.literal: Laborers: 65,000; silver: 200,000 taels; deadline: six months.
translations.idiomatic: It would require 65,000 laborers and 200,000 taels of silver, with a six-month deadline.

sentences.zh: 工未成，會旱災修省，言者多謂開河非計，帝遽令罷役。

translations.literal: Before the work was finished, a drought led the court to austerity; many said opening the river was unwise and the emperor abruptly ordered the labor halted.
translations.idiomatic: Before the work was finished, a drought prompted austerity measures; many argued that opening the new canal was unwise, and the emperor abruptly ordered the labor halted.

sentences.zh: 應期請展一月竟其功，不聽。

translations.literal: Yingqi asked for one more month to finish; he was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi asked for one more month to finish the work, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 初，應期請令郎中柯維熊分浚支河，維熊力贊新河之議，至是亦言不便。

translations.literal: Earlier Yingqi had asked that the director Ke Weixiong dredge branch canals separately; Weixiong had strongly supported the new canal plan, but now also said it was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yingqi had assigned Director Ke Weixiong to dredge branch canals separately; Weixiong had strongly supported the new canal plan, but now also declared it impractical.

sentences.zh: 應期上章自理，帝怒，詔與維熊俱奪職。

translations.literal: Yingqi submitted a memorial in his own defense; the emperor was angry and ordered both him and Weixiong dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi submitted a memorial in his own defense; the emperor was angry and ordered both him and Weixiong stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 世寧言：「新河之議倡自臣。

translations.literal: Shining said: "The proposal for the new canal originated with me.
translations.idiomatic: Shining said, "The proposal for the new canal originated with me.

sentences.zh: 應期克期六月，今四月，功已八九。

translations.literal: Yingqi set a six-month deadline; it is now the fourth month and the work is eight or nine tenths done.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi set a six-month deadline; it is now the fourth month and the work is eight or nine tenths complete.

sentences.zh: 緣程工促急，怨讟煩興。

translations.literal: Because the schedule pressed the labor hard, complaints and slander arose.
translations.idiomatic: Because the tight schedule pressed the laborers hard, complaints and slander arose.

sentences.zh: 維熊反覆變詐，傾大臣，誤國事。

translations.literal: Weixiong turned and deceived repeatedly, overthrew a great minister, and harmed state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Weixiong reversed himself deceitfully, brought down a senior minister, and harmed state affairs.

sentences.zh: 自古國家僨大事，必責首議，臣請與同罷。

translations.literal: Since antiquity when the state failed in a great matter it always blamed the first proposer; I ask to be dismissed together with him.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, when the state failed in a great undertaking it always held the first proposer responsible; I ask to be dismissed along with him.

sentences.zh: 」帝不許。

translations.literal: " The emperor did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor did not agree.

sentences.zh: 後更赦，復官致仕，卒。

translations.literal: Later, after another amnesty, his office was restored and he retired; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after another amnesty, his office was restored and he retired; he then died.

sentences.zh: 應期罷後三十年，朱衡循新河遺跡成之，運道蒙利焉。

translations.literal: Thirty years after Yingqi's dismissal, Zhu Heng followed the traces of the new canal and completed it, and the transport route benefited.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty years after Yingqi's dismissal, Zhu Heng followed the traces of the new canal and completed it, and the transport route reaped the benefit.

sentences.zh: 朱衡，字士南，萬安人。

translations.literal: Zhu Heng, styled Shinan, was a man of Wan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Heng, styled Shinan, was a native of Wan'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年進士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 歷知尤溪、婺源，有治聲。

translations.literal: He served successively as magistrate of Youxi and Wuyuan and gained a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as magistrate of Youxi and Wuyuan and earned a reputation for effective governance.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部主事，歷郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments and served as a director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments and rose to director.

sentences.zh: 出為福建提學副使，累官山東布政使。

translations.literal: He went out as Fujian education vice commissioner and rose to Shandong administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as Fujian education vice commissioner and eventually rose to administration commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，進右副都御史巡撫其地。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of that province.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「比遼左告饑，暫弛登、萊商禁，轉粟濟之。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Recently the east of Liaodong reported famine; the commercial ban on Deng and Lai was temporarily relaxed and grain was shipped to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Recently eastern Liaodong reported famine; the commercial ban on Dengzhou and Laizhou was temporarily relaxed and grain was shipped to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 猾商遂竊載他貨，往來販易，並開青州以西路。

translations.literal: Crafty merchants then secretly loaded other goods and traded back and forth, also opening routes west of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Crafty merchants then secretly loaded other goods and traded back and forth, also opening routes west of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 海島亡命，陰相構結，禁之便。

translations.literal: Outlaws on the sea islands secretly joined together; it would be well to forbid this.
translations.idiomatic: Outlaws on the coastal islands were secretly in league with them; it would be best to forbid this again.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 召為工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was summoned as right vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as right vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，進南京刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was promoted to minister of Punishments at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he was promoted to minister of Punishments at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 其秋，河決沛縣飛雲橋，東註昭陽湖，運道淤塞百餘里。

translations.literal: That autumn the river burst at Feiyun Bridge in Pei County and flowed east into Zhaoyang Lake; the transport route silted for more than 100 li.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river burst at Feiyun Bridge in Pei County and flowed east into Zhaoyang Lake, silting the transport route for more than 100 li.

sentences.zh: 改衡工部尚書兼右副都御史，總理河漕。

translations.literal: Heng was changed to minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief to oversee rivers and grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Heng was reassigned as minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief to oversee rivers and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 衡馳至決口，舊渠已成陸。

translations.literal: Heng rushed to the breach; the old canal had become dry land.
translations.idiomatic: Heng rushed to the breach; the old canal had become dry land.

sentences.zh: 而故都御史盛應期所開新河，自南陽以南東至夏村，又東南至留城，故址尚在。

translations.literal: But the new canal opened by the former censor-in-chief Sheng Yingqi, from south of Nanyang east to Xiacun and then southeast to Liucheng, still had its traces.
translations.idiomatic: But the new canal opened by the former censor-in-chief Sheng Yingqi, running from south of Nanyang east to Xiacun and then southeast to Liucheng, still had its traces.

sentences.zh: 其地高，河決至昭陽湖止，不能復東，可以通運，乃定議開新河，築堤呂孟湖以防潰決。

translations.literal: The ground there was high; when the river burst it stopped at Zhaoyang Lake and could not flow east again, yet transport could pass—so they decided to open the new canal and build dikes at Lümeng Lake to prevent breaches.
translations.idiomatic: The ground there was high; when the river burst it stopped at Zhaoyang Lake and could not flow farther east, yet transport could still pass—so they decided to open the new canal and build dikes at Lümeng Lake to prevent breaches.

sentences.zh: 河道都御史潘季馴以為浚舊渠便，議與衡不合。

translations.literal: The river-route censor-in-chief Pan Jixun thought dredging the old canal was better; his plan did not agree with Heng's.
translations.idiomatic: River-route Censor-in-Chief Pan Jixun argued that dredging the old canal would be better, and his plan clashed with Heng's.

sentences.zh: 衡持益堅，引鮎魚、薛沙諸水入新渠，築馬家橋堤以遏飛雲橋決口，身自督工。

translations.literal: Heng held all the firmer, drew the Nianyu, Xuesha, and other waters into the new channel, built the Majiaqiao dike to block the Feiyun Bridge breach, and personally supervised the work.
translations.idiomatic: Heng held firm, diverted the Nianyu, Xuesha, and other streams into the new channel, built the Majiaqiao dike to block the Feiyun Bridge breach, and personally supervised the work.

sentences.zh: 劾罷曹濮副使柴淶，重繩吏卒不用命者，浮議遂起。

translations.literal: He impeached and removed the Cao-Pu vice commissioner Chai Lian and strictly punished clerks and soldiers who disobeyed; loose talk then arose.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached and removed the Cao-Pu vice commissioner Chai Lian and strictly punished clerks and soldiers who disobeyed orders, and loose talk soon arose.

sentences.zh: 明年，給事中鄭欽劾衡虐民幸功，詔遣給事中何起鳴往勘，工垂竣矣。

translations.literal: The next year the supervising secretary Zheng Qin impeached Heng for oppressing the people to claim merit; the emperor ordered the supervising secretary He Qiming to investigate; the work was nearly finished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Supervising Secretary Zheng Qin impeached Heng for oppressing the people to claim merit; the emperor ordered Supervising Secretary He Qiming to investigate on site; the work was nearly finished.

sentences.zh: 及秋，河決馬家橋，議者紛然謂功不可成。

translations.literal: By autumn the river burst at Majiaqiao; debaters clamored that the work could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: By autumn the river burst at Majiaqiao, and critics clamored that the project could not succeed.

sentences.zh: 起鳴初主衡議，亦變其說，與給事中王元春、御史黃襄交章請罷衡。

translations.literal: Qiming had at first supported Heng's plan but also changed his view; with the supervising secretary Wang Yuanchun and the censor Huang Xiang he submitted successive memorials asking to remove Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Qiming had initially supported Heng's plan but changed his position as well; together with Supervising Secretary Wang Yuanchun and Censor Huang Xiang he submitted successive memorials asking that Heng be removed.

sentences.zh: 會新河已成，乃止。

translations.literal: Just then the new canal was completed, and they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the new canal was completed, and the calls to remove him ceased.

sentences.zh: 河長一百九十四里。

translations.literal: The canal was 194 li long.
translations.idiomatic: The canal was 194 li long.

sentences.zh: 漕艘由境山入，通行至南陽。

translations.literal: Grain boats entered at Jingshan and could pass through to Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Grain boats entered at Jingshan and could pass through to Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 未幾，季馴以憂去，詔衡兼理其事。

translations.literal: Before long Jixun left on mourning leave and the emperor ordered Heng to take charge of that duty as well.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Jixun left on mourning leave, and the emperor ordered Heng to take charge of river-route affairs as well.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 山水驟溢，決新河，壞漕艘數百。

translations.literal: Mountain floods suddenly swelled, breached the new canal, and destroyed several hundred grain boats.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain floods suddenly swelled, breached the new canal, and destroyed several hundred grain boats.

sentences.zh: 給事中吳時來言：「新河受東、兗以南費、嶧、鄒、滕之水。

translations.literal: The supervising secretary Wu Shilai said: "The new canal receives the waters of Fei, Yi, Zou, and Teng south of Dong and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Wu Shilai said, "The new canal receives the waters of Fei, Yi, Zou, and Teng south of Dong and Yan.

sentences.zh: 以一堤捍群流，豈能不潰？

translations.literal: With one dike holding back many streams, how can it not burst?
translations.idiomatic: With a single dike holding back so many streams, how can it fail to burst?

sentences.zh: 宜分之以殺其勢。

translations.literal: They should be divided to reduce their force.
translations.idiomatic: They should be divided to reduce their force.

sentences.zh: 」衡乃開支河四，泄其水入赤山湖。

translations.literal: " Heng then opened four branch canals and discharged the water into Chishan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: " Heng then opened four branch canals and discharged the water into Chishan Lake.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，召還部。

translations.literal: The next autumn he was recalled to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn he was recalled to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 又明年，衡上疏曰：「先臣宋禮浚治舊渠，測量水平，計濟寧平地與徐州境山巔相準，北高南下，懸流三十丈。

translations.literal: The year after that Heng submitted a memorial saying: "The former minister Song Li dredged the old canal, measured the water level, and calculated that the flat ground at Jining was level with the summit of Jingshan in Xuzhou—higher in the north and lower in the south, a drop of thirty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Heng submitted a memorial saying, "The former minister Song Li dredged the old canal, measured water levels, and found that the flat ground at Jining was level with the summit of Jingshan in Xuzhou—higher in the north and lower in the south, a drop of thirty zhang.

sentences.zh: 故魯橋閘以南稍啟立涸，舟行半月始達。

translations.literal: Therefore south of the Luqiao lock the gates had to be opened slightly and then closed to hold water; boats took half a month to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore south of the Luqiao lock the gates had to be opened slightly and then closed to hold water, and boats took half a month to pass through.

sentences.zh: 東、兗之民增閘挑淺，苦力役者百六十年。

translations.literal: The people of Dong and Yan added locks and dredged shallows, suffering corvée labor for 160 years.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Dong and Yan added locks and dredged shallows, suffering corvée labor for 160 years.

sentences.zh: 屬者改鑿新渠，遠避黃流，舍卑就高，地形平衍，諸閘不煩起閉，舟行日可百餘里，夫役漫無事事。

translations.literal: Recently the new canal was cut to keep far from the Yellow River current, abandoning low ground for high; the terrain is level, the locks need not be opened and closed, boats can travel more than 100 li a day, and laborers have little to do.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the new canal was cut to keep clear of the Yellow River current, abandoning low ground for high; the terrain is level, the locks need not be opened and closed, boats can travel more than 100 li a day, and laborers have little to do.

sentences.zh: 近河道都御史翁大立奏請裁革，宜可聽。

translations.literal: Recently the river-route censor-in-chief Weng Dali memorialized to cut and abolish [these posts]; this should be approved.
translations.idiomatic: Recently River-route Censor-in-Chief Weng Dali memorialized to cut these posts; this should be approved.

sentences.zh: 」於是汰閘官五，夫役六千余，以其僦直為修渠費。

translations.literal: " Thereupon five lock officials and more than 6,000 laborers were cut, and their hire payments were used for canal repair.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon five lock officials and more than 6,000 laborers were cut, and their hire payments were used for canal repair.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，河決睢寧，起季馴總理。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year the river burst at Suining and Jixun was recalled as supreme commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year the river burst at Suining and Jixun was recalled as supreme commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，閱視河道給事中雒遵劾罷季馴，言廷臣可使，無出衡右者。

translations.literal: The next winter the inspecting supervising secretary Luo Zun impeached and removed Jixun, saying that among court officials none was better than Heng.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter the inspecting supervising secretary Luo Zun impeached and removed Jixun, saying that among court officials none was better than Heng.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，詔兼左副都御史，經理河道。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year he was ordered to serve concurrently as left vice censor-in-chief to manage the river route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year he was ordered to serve concurrently as left vice censor-in-chief to manage the river route.

sentences.zh: 穆宗崩，大學士高拱以山陵工請召衡。

translations.literal: When the Muzong emperor died, Grand Secretary Gao Gong asked to recall Heng for the imperial tomb works.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muzong emperor died, Grand Secretary Gao Gong asked to recall Heng for the imperial tomb works.

sentences.zh: 會邳州工亦竣，衡遂還朝。

translations.literal: Just then the Pizhou works were also finished and Heng returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the Pizhou works were also finished and Heng returned to court.

sentences.zh: 衡先後在部，禁止工作，裁抑浮費，所節省甚眾。

translations.literal: During Heng's successive terms in the ministry he halted works, cut wasteful spending, and saved a great deal.
translations.idiomatic: During Heng's successive terms in the ministry he halted unnecessary works, cut wasteful spending, and saved a great deal.

sentences.zh: 穆宗時，內府監局加征工料，濫用不訾，衡隨時執奏。

translations.literal: Under Muzong the inner palace directorates added labor and materials levies and spent recklessly; Heng memorialized against this whenever it occurred.
translations.idiomatic: Under Muzong the inner palace directorates added labor and materials levies and spent recklessly; Heng memorialized against this whenever it occurred.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔南京織造太監李佑趨辦袍緞千八百余匹，衡因言官孫枝、姚繼可、嚴用和、駱問禮先後諫，再疏請，從之。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor ordered the Nanjing weaving eunuch Li You to hurry production of more than 1,800 bolts of robe satin; Heng cited the remonstrances of the officials Sun Zhi, Yao Jike, Yan Yonghe, and Luo Wenli and memorialized again; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor ordered the Nanjing weaving eunuch Li You to hurry production of more than 1,800 bolts of robe satin; Heng cited the remonstrances of the officials Sun Zhi, Yao Jike, Yan Yonghe, and Luo Wenli and memorialized again, and the order was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 帝切責太監崔敏，傳令南京加造緞十余萬匹。

translations.literal: The emperor sharply rebuked the eunuch Cui Min and ordered Nanjing to add more than 100,000 bolts of satin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sharply rebuked the eunuch Cui Min and ordered Nanjing to add more than 100,000 bolts of satin.

sentences.zh: 衡議停新造，但責歲額，得減新造三之二。

translations.literal: Heng proposed halting new production and requiring only the annual quota, reducing new production by two thirds.
translations.idiomatic: Heng proposed halting new production and requiring only the annual quota, reducing new production by two thirds.

sentences.zh: 命造鰲山燈，計費三萬余兩，又命建光泰殿、瑞祥閣於長信門，衡皆奏止之。

translations.literal: He was ordered to make the Aoshan lantern, costing more than 30,000 taels, and to build the Guangtai Hall and Ruixiang Pavilion at the Changxin Gate; Heng memorialized to stop all of these.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to make the Aoshan lantern, costing more than 30,000 taels, and to build the Guangtai Hall and Ruixiang Pavilion at the Changxin Gate; Heng memorialized to stop all of these.

sentences.zh: 及神宗即位，首命停織造，而內臣不即奉詔，且請增織染所顏料。

translations.literal: When the Shenzong emperor ascended the throne his first order was to halt weaving, but the inner eunuchs did not immediately obey and asked to increase dyes for the dyeing offices.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shenzong emperor ascended the throne his first order was to halt weaving, but the inner eunuchs did not immediately obey and asked to increase dyes for the dyeing offices.

sentences.zh: 衡奏爭，皆得請。

translations.literal: Heng memorialized in protest and in each case prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: Heng memorialized in protest and in each case prevailed.

sentences.zh: 皇太后傳諭發帑金修涿州碧霞元君廟。

translations.literal: The empress dowager transmitted an order to disburse treasury funds to repair the Bixia Yuanjun Temple in Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager transmitted an order to disburse treasury funds to repair the Bixia Yuanjun Temple in Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 衡復爭，報聞。

translations.literal: Heng protested again; word came back [that it was stopped].
translations.idiomatic: Heng protested again, and word came back that the order was stopped.

sentences.zh: 衡性強直，遇事不撓，不為張居正所喜。

translations.literal: Heng was forceful and upright by nature, unyielding in affairs, and was not liked by Zhang Juzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Heng was forceful and upright by nature, unyielding in affairs, and was not liked by Zhang Juzheng.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二年，給事中林景旸劾衡剛愎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wanli the supervising secretary Lin Jingyang impeached Heng for obstinacy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wanli Supervising Secretary Lin Jingyang impeached Heng for obstinacy.

sentences.zh: 衡再疏乞休。

translations.literal: Heng memorialized again asking to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Heng memorialized again asking to retire.

sentences.zh: 詔加太子太保，馳驛歸。

translations.literal: He was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and sent home by express post.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and sent home by express post.

sentences.zh: 其年夏，大雨壞昭陵恩殿，追論督工罪，奪宮保。

translations.literal: That summer heavy rain destroyed the grace hall of the Zhaoling tomb; his supervision of the works was reviewed and his Grand Mentor title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: That summer heavy rain destroyed the grace hall of the Zhaoling tomb; his supervision of the works was reviewed and his Grand Mentor title was stripped.

sentences.zh: 卒年七十三。

translations.literal: He died at seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 子維京，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Weijing has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Weijing has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 翁大立，余姚人。

translations.literal: Weng Dali was a man of Yuyao.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Dali was a native of Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年進士。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 累官山東左布政使。

translations.literal: He rose to left administration commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to left administration commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，以右副都御史巡撫應天、蘇州諸府。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was made right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Yingtian and the Suzhou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year he was made right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Yingtian and the Suzhou prefectures.

sentences.zh: 蘇州以倭警募壯士，後兵罷無所歸，群聚剽奪。

translations.literal: Suzhou had recruited strong men because of the wokou alarm; after the troops were disbanded they had nowhere to go and gathered to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou had recruited strong men because of the wokou alarm; after the troops were disbanded they had nowhere to go and gathered to plunder.

sentences.zh: 大立得其主名，捕甚急。

translations.literal: Dali learned the ringleader's name and pressed the arrest urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Dali learned the ringleader's name and pressed the arrest urgently.

sentences.zh: 惡少懼，夜劫縣衛獄，縱囚自隨，攻都御史行署，大立率妻子遁。

translations.literal: The ruffians were afraid; by night they raided the county guard prison, freed prisoners to follow them, and attacked the censor-in-chief's quarters; Dali fled with his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: The ruffians were afraid; by night they raided the county guard prison, freed prisoners to follow them, and attacked the censor-in-chief's quarters; Dali fled with his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 知府王道行督兵力拒之，乃斬葑門，奔入太湖為盜。

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Daoxing directed troops to resist them; they then cut through the Feng Gate and fled into Lake Tai as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Daoxing directed troops to resist them; they then cut through the Feng Gate and fled into Lake Tai as bandits.

sentences.zh: 命大立戴罪捕賊，尋被劾罷。

translations.literal: Dali was ordered to capture the bandits while under penalty; he was soon impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Dali was ordered to capture the bandits while under penalty; he was soon impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 久之，起故官，巡撫山東。

translations.literal: After a long time he was recalled to his former post as grand coordinator of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was recalled to his former post as grand coordinator of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 遭喪不赴。

translations.literal: He encountered mourning and did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He encountered mourning and did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年，命督河道。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longqing he was ordered to supervise the river route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longqing he was ordered to supervise the river route.

sentences.zh: 朱衡既開新河，漕渠便利。

translations.literal: After Zhu Heng had opened the new canal, the grain transport route was convenient.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhu Heng had opened the new canal, the grain transport route was convenient.

sentences.zh: 大立因頌新河之利有五，而請浚回回墓以達鴻溝，引昭陽之水沿鴻溝出留城，以溉湖下腴田千頃。

translations.literal: Dali therefore praised five benefits of the new canal and asked to dredge the Huihui tomb [channel] to reach the Honggou, drawing Zhaoyang Lake water along the Honggou out at Liucheng to irrigate a thousand qing of fertile fields below the lake.
translations.idiomatic: Dali therefore praised five benefits of the new canal and asked to dredge the Huihui tomb channel to reach the Honggou, drawing Zhaoyang Lake water along the Honggou out at Liucheng to irrigate a thousand qing of fertile fields below the lake.

sentences.zh: 未幾，又請鑿邵家嶺，令水由地浜溝出境山，入漕河。

translations.literal: Before long he also asked to cut through Shaojialing so water could pass through the Dibin ditch at Jingshan into the grain canal.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he also asked to cut through Shaojialing so water could pass through the Dibin ditch at Jingshan into the grain canal.

sentences.zh: 帝皆從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all of these.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of these.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，河大決沛縣，漕艘阻不進。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year the river burst badly at Pei County and grain boats were blocked and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year the river burst badly at Pei County and grain boats were blocked and could not advance.

sentences.zh: 帝從大立請，大行振貸。

translations.literal: The emperor followed Dali's request and carried out large-scale relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed Dali's request and carried out large-scale relief loans.

sentences.zh: 大立又請漕艘後至者貯粟徐州倉，平價出糶。

translations.literal: Dali also asked that grain boats arriving later store grain in the Xuzhou granary and sell it at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: Dali also asked that grain boats arriving later store grain in the Xuzhou granary and sell it at fair price.

sentences.zh: 詔許以三萬石賚民。

translations.literal: The emperor approved using 30,000 piculs to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved using 30,000 piculs to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 大立以下民昏墊、閭閻愁困狀帝莫能周知，乃繪圖十二以獻。

translations.literal: Dali thought the emperor could not fully know how the lower people were mired and how neighborhoods were distressed, and so painted twelve pictures to present.
translations.idiomatic: Dali thought the emperor could not fully know how the common people were mired in hardship and how neighborhoods were in distress, and so painted twelve pictures to present.

sentences.zh: 且言：「時事可憂，更不止此。

translations.literal: He also said: "Present affairs are worrisome and go beyond this.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Present affairs are worrisome and go beyond this.

sentences.zh: 東南財賦區，而江海泛溢，粒米不登，京儲可慮一也。

translations.literal: The southeast is the region of wealth and taxes, yet rivers and sea overflow and grain does not ripen—the capital stores are the first worry.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast is the region of wealth and taxes, yet rivers and sea overflow and grain does not ripen—the capital stores are the first worry.

sentences.zh: 邊關千里，悉遭洪水，墩堡傾頹，何恃以守？

translations.literal: Border passes for a thousand li have all suffered floods; beacon towers and forts have collapsed—what can we rely on to defend?
translations.idiomatic: Border passes for a thousand li have all suffered floods; beacon towers and forts have collapsed—what can we rely on to defend?

sentences.zh: 可慮二也。

translations.literal: This is the second worry.
translations.idiomatic: This is the second worry.

sentences.zh: 畿輔、山東、河南，霪雨既久，城郭不完，寇盜無備，可慮三也。

translations.literal: The capital region, Shandong, and Henan have had prolonged rains; city walls are incomplete and bandits are unprepared for—this is the third worry.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region, Shandong, and Henan have had prolonged rains; city walls are incomplete and bandits are unprepared for—this is the third worry.

sentences.zh: 江海間颶風鼓浪，舟艦戰卒，悉入波流，海防可慮四也。

translations.literal: Between river and sea hurricanes stir waves; ships and fighting soldiers have all gone into the currents—coastal defense is the fourth worry.
translations.idiomatic: Between river and sea hurricanes stir waves; ships and fighting soldiers have all gone into the currents—coastal defense is the fourth worry.

sentences.zh: 淮、浙鹽場鹹泥盡沒，竈戶流移，商賈不至，國課可慮五也。

translations.literal: Huai and Zhe salt fields are wholly submerged in brine mud; saltern households have fled; merchants do not come—state revenue is the fifth worry.
translations.idiomatic: Huai and Zhe salt fields are wholly submerged in brine mud; saltern households have fled; merchants do not come—state revenue is the fifth worry.

sentences.zh: 望陛下以五患十二圖付公卿博議，速求拯濟之策。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will entrust the five worries and twelve pictures to the high officials for broad discussion and quickly seek policies of relief.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will entrust the five worries and twelve pictures to the high officials for broad discussion and quickly seek policies of relief.

sentences.zh: 」帝留圖備覽，下其奏於所司。

translations.literal: " The emperor kept the pictures for reference and sent his memorial to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor kept the pictures for reference and sent his memorial to the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 當是時，黃河既決，淮水復漲。

translations.literal: At that time the Yellow River had already burst and the Huai River had risen again.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Yellow River had already burst and the Huai River had risen again.

sentences.zh: 自清河縣至通濟閘抵淮安城西淤三十餘里，決方、信二壩出海，平地水深丈余，寶應湖堤往往崩壞。

translations.literal: From Qinghe County to the Tongji Lock and west of Huai'an city it silted for more than thirty li; the Fang and Xin dams were breached to discharge to the sea; on flat ground water was more than a zhang deep; the Baoying Lake dikes often collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: From Qinghe County to the Tongji Lock and west of Huai'an city it silted for more than thirty li; the Fang and Xin dams were breached to discharge to the sea; on flat ground water was more than a zhang deep; the Baoying Lake dikes often collapsed.

sentences.zh: 山東沂、莒、郯城水溢，從沂河、直河出邳州，人民多溺死。

translations.literal: In Shandong Yi, Ju, and Tancheng overflowed; water went out through the Yi River and Zhih River at Pizhou and many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In Shandong Yi, Ju, and Tancheng overflowed; water went out through the Yi River and Zhih River at Pizhou and many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 大立奔走經營，至四年六月，鴻溝、境山諸工，及淮流疏浚，次第告成。

translations.literal: Dali rushed about managing affairs; by the sixth month of the fourth year the Honggou and Jingshan works and Huai River dredging were completed in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Dali rushed about managing affairs; by the sixth month of the fourth year the Honggou and Jingshan works and Huai River dredging were completed in turn.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，錫賚有差。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and bestowed rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and bestowed rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 時大立已升工部右侍郎，旋改兵部，為左。

translations.literal: By then Dali had been promoted to right vice minister of Works, then transferred to War and made left vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: By then Dali had been promoted to right vice minister of Works, then transferred to War and made left vice minister.

sentences.zh: 會代者陳大賓未至，而山東沙、薛、汶、泗諸水驟漲，決仲家淺諸處，黃河又暴至，茶城復淤。

translations.literal: His successor Chen Dabin had not yet arrived when Shandong's Sha, Xue, Wen, and Si waters suddenly rose, breached at Zhongjiaqian and elsewhere, the Yellow River surged again, and Chacheng silted once more.
translations.idiomatic: His successor Chen Dabin had not yet arrived when Shandong's Sha, Xue, Wen, and Si waters suddenly rose, breached at Zhongjiaqian and elsewhere, the Yellow River surged again, and Chacheng silted once more.

sentences.zh: 已而淮自泰山廟至七里溝亦淤十餘里。

translations.literal: Soon the Huai from Taishan Temple to Qiligou also silted for more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Huai from Taishan Temple to Qiligou also silted for more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 其明年，遂為給事中宋良佐劾罷。

translations.literal: The next year he was impeached and dismissed by the supervising secretary Song Liangzuo.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was impeached and dismissed by Supervising Secretary Song Liangzuo.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二年，起南京刑部右侍郎，就改吏部。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wanli he was recalled as right vice minister of Punishments at Nanjing and then transferred to Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wanli he was recalled as right vice minister of Punishments at Nanjing and then transferred to Personnel.

sentences.zh: 明年入為刑部右侍郎，再遷南京兵部尚書。

translations.literal: The next year he entered the capital as right vice minister of Punishments and was again transferred to minister of War at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he entered the capital as right vice minister of Punishments and was again transferred to minister of War at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 六年，致仕歸。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he retired and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he retired and returned home.

sentences.zh: 先是，隆慶末，有錦衣指揮周世臣者，外戚慶雲侯裔也。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the end of Longqing, there was a Brocade Guard commandant Zhou Shichen, a descendant of the Marquis of Qingyun by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the end of Longqing, there was a Brocade Guard commandant Zhou Shichen, a descendant of the Marquis of Qingyun by marriage.

sentences.zh: 家貧無妻，獨與婢荷花兒居。

translations.literal: His family was poor and he had no wife; he lived alone with the maid Hehua'er.
translations.idiomatic: His family was poor and he had no wife; he lived alone with the maid Hehua'er.

sentences.zh: 盜入其室，殺世臣去。

translations.literal: Thieves entered his room, killed Shichen, and left.
translations.idiomatic: Thieves entered his room, killed Shichen, and left.

sentences.zh: 把總張國維入捕盜，惟荷花兒及仆王奎在，遂謂二人奸弒其主。

translations.literal: The garrison commander Zhang Guowei entered to catch the thieves; only Hehua'er and the servant Wang Kui were there, so he said the two had committed adultery and murdered their master.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commander Zhang Guowei entered to catch the thieves; only Hehua'er and the servant Wang Kui were there, so he said the two had committed adultery and murdered their master.

sentences.zh: 獄成，刑部郎中潘誌伊疑之，久不決。

translations.literal: The case was concluded; the Ministry of Punishments director Pan Zhiyi doubted it and long delayed decision.
translations.idiomatic: The case was concluded; Ministry of Punishments Director Pan Zhiyi doubted it and long delayed a decision.

sentences.zh: 及大立以侍郎署部事，憤荷花兒弒主，趣誌伊速決。

translations.literal: When Dali served as vice minister in charge of the ministry, angry that Hehua'er had murdered her master, he pressed Zhiyi to decide quickly.
translations.idiomatic: When Dali served as vice minister in charge of the ministry, angry that Hehua'er had murdered her master, he pressed Zhiyi to decide quickly.

sentences.zh: 誌伊終疑之，乃委郎中王三錫、徐一忠同讞。

translations.literal: Zhiyi still doubted and delegated the directors Wang Sanxi and Xu Yizhong to judge together.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyi still doubted and delegated the directors Wang Sanxi and Xu Yizhong to judge together.

sentences.zh: 竟無所平反，置極刑。

translations.literal: In the end they found no grounds to reverse the verdict and imposed the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: In the end they found no grounds to reverse the verdict and imposed the extreme penalty.

sentences.zh: 逾數年，獲真盜。

translations.literal: After several years the real thieves were captured.
translations.idiomatic: After several years the real thieves were captured.

sentences.zh: 都人競稱荷花兒冤，流聞禁中。

translations.literal: People in the capital all said Hehua'er had been wronged; the story reached the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: People in the capital all said Hehua'er had been wronged; the story reached the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，欲重譴大立等。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angry and wished to punish Dali and the others severely.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly angry and wished to punish Dali and the others severely.

sentences.zh: 會給事中周良寅、蕭彥復劾之，乃追奪大立職，調一忠、三錫於外。

translations.literal: When the supervising secretaries Zhou Liangyin and Xiao Yan again impeached them, Dali's office was posthumously stripped and Yizhong and Sanxi were transferred outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Supervising Secretaries Zhou Liangyin and Xiao Yan again impeached them, Dali's office was stripped and Yizhong and Sanxi were transferred outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 誌伊時已知九江府，亦謫知陳州。

translations.literal: Zhiyi was then prefect of Jiujiang and was also demoted to prefect of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyi was then prefect of Jiujiang and was also demoted to prefect of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 誌伊，吳江人。

translations.literal: Zhiyi was a man of Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyi was a native of Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 進士，終廣西右參政。

translations.literal: A jinshi, he ended as right vice commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi, he ended his career as right vice commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 歷官有聲。

translations.literal: Throughout his offices he had a good reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his offices he had a good reputation.

sentences.zh: 潘季馴，字時良，烏程人。

translations.literal: Pan Jixun, styled Shiliang, was a man of Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Jixun, styled Shiliang, was a native of Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十九年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授九江推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed investigating censor of Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating censor of Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 擢御史，巡撫廣東。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor and grand coordinator of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor and appointed grand coordinator of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 行均平裏甲法，廣人大便。

translations.literal: He implemented the equalized lijia method; the people of Guang greatly benefited.
translations.idiomatic: He implemented the equalized lijia method; the people of Guangdong greatly benefited.

sentences.zh: 臨代去，疏請飭後至者守其法，帝從之。

translations.literal: As he was about to leave at the end of his term, he memorialized asking that his successor be ordered to keep his methods; the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: As he was about to leave at the end of his term, he memorialized asking that his successor be ordered to keep his methods; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 進大理丞。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，由左少卿進右僉都御史，總理河道。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, from left vice director he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief to oversee the river route.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, from left vice director he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief to oversee the river route.

sentences.zh: 與朱衡共開新河，加右副都御史。

translations.literal: Together with Zhu Heng he opened the new canal and was made right vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Zhu Heng he opened the new canal and was made right vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋以憂去。

translations.literal: Soon he left on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he left on mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 隆慶四年，河決邳州、睢寧。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Longqing the river burst at Pizhou and Suining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Longqing the river burst at Pizhou and Suining.

sentences.zh: 起故官，再理河道，塞決口。

translations.literal: He was recalled to his former post to manage the river route again and block the breach.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to his former post to manage the river route again and block the breach.

sentences.zh: 明年，工竣，坐驅運船入新溜漂沒多，為勘河給事中雒遵劾罷。

translations.literal: The next year the work was finished; because many transport boats driven into the new current were lost, he was impeached and dismissed by the inspecting supervising secretary Luo Zun.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the work was finished; because many transport boats driven into the new current were lost, he was impeached and dismissed by the inspecting supervising secretary Luo Zun.

sentences.zh: 萬歷四年夏，再起官，巡撫江西。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer of Wanli he was recalled and made grand coordinator of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer of Wanli he was recalled and appointed grand coordinator of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，召為刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: The next winter he was summoned as right vice minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter he was summoned as right vice minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 是時，河決崔鎮，黃水北流，清河口淤澱，全淮南徙，高堰湖堤大壞，淮、揚、高郵、寶應間皆為巨浸。

translations.literal: At that time the river burst at Cuizhen; Yellow River water flowed north; Qinghekou silted; the whole Huai shifted south; the Gaoyan lake dikes were badly damaged; and between Huai, Yang, Gaoyou, and Baoying all became a vast flood.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the river burst at Cuizhen; Yellow River water flowed north; Qinghekou silted up; the whole Huai shifted south; the Gaoyan lake dikes were badly damaged; and the region between the Huai, Yangzhou, Gaoyou, and Baoying became a vast flood.

sentences.zh: 大學士張居正深以為憂。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng was deeply worried.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng was deeply worried.

sentences.zh: 河漕尚書吳桂芳議復老黃河故道，而總河都御史傅希摯欲塞決口，束水歸漕，兩人議不合。

translations.literal: River and grain transport minister Wu Guifang proposed restoring the old Yellow River route, while the supreme river-route censor Fu Xizhi wanted to block the breach and confine the water to the grain route; the two plans did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: River and grain transport minister Wu Guifang proposed restoring the old Yellow River route, while Supreme River-route Censor Fu Xizhi wanted to block the breach and confine the water to the grain route; the two plans clashed.

sentences.zh: 會桂芳卒，六年夏，命季馴以右都御史兼工部左侍郎代之。

translations.literal: When Guifang died, in the sixth summer Jixun was ordered as right censor-in-chief with concurrent left vice minister of Works to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When Guifang died, in the sixth summer Jixun was ordered as right censor-in-chief with concurrent left vice minister of Works to replace him.

sentences.zh: 季馴以故道久湮，雖浚復，其深廣必不能如今河，議築崔鎮以塞決口，築遙堤以防潰決。

translations.literal: Jixun thought the old route had long been buried; even if dredged, its depth and breadth could not match the present river; he proposed building at Cuizhen to block the breach and building distant dikes to prevent collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun thought the old route had long been buried; even if dredged, its depth and breadth could not match the present river; he proposed building at Cuizhen to block the breach and building distant dikes to prevent collapse.

sentences.zh: 又：「淮清河濁，淮弱河強，河水一斗，沙居其六，伏秋則居其八，非極湍急，必至停滯。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Huai is clear and the Yellow River muddy; the Huai is weak and the river strong. In one dou of river water, sand is six tenths; in flood season it is eight tenths. Unless the current is extremely swift, it must stagnate.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The Huai is clear and the Yellow River muddy; the Huai is weak and the river strong. In one dou of river water, sand is six tenths; in flood season it is eight tenths. Unless the current is extremely swift, it must stagnate.

sentences.zh: 當藉淮之清以刷河之濁，築高堰束淮入清口，以敵河之強，使二水並流，則海口自浚。

translations.literal: One must borrow the Huai's clarity to scour the river's mud, build the Gaoyan dike to confine the Huai into Qingkou to match the river's strength, and let the two waters flow together—then the sea mouth will scour itself.
translations.idiomatic: One must borrow the Huai's clarity to scour the river's mud, build the Gaoyan dike to confine the Huai into Qingkou to match the river's strength, and let the two waters flow together—then the sea mouth will scour itself.

sentences.zh: 即桂芳所開草灣，亦可不復修治。

translations.literal: Even the Caowan that Guifang opened need not be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Even the Caowan that Guifang opened need not be repaired.

sentences.zh: 」遂條上六事，詔如議。

translations.literal: " He then submitted six items; the emperor approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " He then submitted six items; the emperor approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，兩河工成。

translations.literal: The next winter work on both rivers was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter work on both rivers was finished.

sentences.zh: 又明年春，加太子太保，進工部尚書兼左副都御史。

translations.literal: The next spring he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and promoted to minister of Works with concurrent left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and promoted to minister of Works with concurrent left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 季馴初至河上，歷虞城、夏邑、商丘，相度地勢。

translations.literal: When Jixun first reached the river he went through Yucheng, Xiayi, and Shangqiu to survey the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: When Jixun first reached the river he went through Yucheng, Xiayi, and Shangqiu to survey the terrain.

sentences.zh: 舊黃河上流，自新集經趙家圈、蕭縣，出徐州小浮橋，極深廣。

translations.literal: The old upper Yellow River from Xinji through Zhaojiaquan and Xiao County exited at the small floating bridge of Xuzhou, extremely deep and broad.
translations.idiomatic: The old upper Yellow River from Xinji through Zhaojiaquan and Xiao County exited at the small floating bridge of Xuzhou, extremely deep and broad.

sentences.zh: 自嘉靖中北徙，河身既淺，遷徙不常，曹、單、豐、沛常苦昏墊。

translations.literal: Since it shifted north in the Jiajing period the riverbed had become shallow and its course unstable; Cao, Shan, Feng, and Pei often suffered inundation.
translations.idiomatic: Since it shifted north in the Jiajing period the riverbed had become shallow and its course unstable; Cao, Shan, Feng, and Pei often suffered inundation.

sentences.zh: 上疏請復故河。

translations.literal: He memorialized to restore the old river.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to restore the old river.

sentences.zh: 給事中王道成以方築崔鎮高堰，役難並舉。

translations.literal: The supervising secretary Wang Daocheng said that with Cuizhen and Gaoyan dikes being built, the works could not be undertaken together.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising secretary Wang Daocheng said that with Cuizhen and Gaoyan dikes being built, the works could not be undertaken together.

sentences.zh: 河南撫按亦陳三難，乃止。

translations.literal: The Henan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner also listed three difficulties, and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner also listed three difficulties, and it was stopped.

sentences.zh: 遷南京兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to minister of War at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to minister of War at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，召改刑部。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year he was summoned and changed to Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year he was summoned and changed to Punishments.

sentences.zh: 季馴之再起也，以張居正援。

translations.literal: When Jixun was recalled it was with Zhang Juzheng's support.
translations.idiomatic: When Jixun was recalled it was with Zhang Juzheng's support.

sentences.zh: 居正歿，家屬盡幽系，子敬修自縊死。

translations.literal: When Juzheng died his family were all imprisoned; his son Jingxiu hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Juzheng died his family were all imprisoned; his son Jingxiu hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 季馴言：「居正母逾八旬，旦暮莫必其命，乞降特恩宥釋。

translations.literal: Jixun said: "Juzheng's mother is over eighty; morning and evening her life is uncertain; I beg special grace for release.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun said, "Juzheng's mother is over eighty; morning and evening her life is uncertain; I beg special grace for release.

sentences.zh: 」又以治居正獄太急，宣言居正家屬斃獄者已數十人。

translations.literal: " He also said that because the case against Juzheng was handled too harshly, he declared that dozens of Juzheng's family had already died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said that because the case against Juzheng was handled too harshly, he declared that dozens of Juzheng's family had already died in prison.

sentences.zh: 先是，御史李植、江東之輩與大臣申時行、楊巍相訐。

translations.literal: Earlier the censors Li Zhi, Jiang Dongzhi, and others had quarreled with the ministers Shen Shixing and Yang Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the censors Li Zhi, Jiang Dongzhi, and others had quarreled with the ministers Shen Shixing and Yang Wei.

sentences.zh: 季馴力右時行、巍，痛詆言者，言者交怒。

translations.literal: Jixun strongly sided with Shixing and Wei and bitterly attacked the critics; the critics were furious in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun strongly sided with Shixing and Wei and bitterly attacked the critics; the critics were furious in turn.

sentences.zh: 植遂劾季馴黨庇居正，落職為民。

translations.literal: Zhi then impeached Jixun for shielding Juzheng and he was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi then impeached Jixun for shielding Juzheng and he was dismissed to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 十三年，御史李棟上疏訟曰：「隆慶間，河決崔鎮，為運道梗。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Censor Li Dong memorialized in defense saying: "In the Longqing period the river burst at Cuizhen and blocked the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Censor Li Dong memorialized in defense saying, "In the Longqing period the river burst at Cuizhen and blocked the transport route.

sentences.zh: 數年以來，民居既奠，河水安流，咸曰：『此潘尚書功也。

translations.literal: For several years since, people have settled and the river flows peacefully; all say: This is Minister Pan's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: For several years since, people have settled and the river flows peacefully; all say, This is Minister Pan's achievement.

sentences.zh: 』昔先臣宋禮治會通河，至於今是賴，陛下允督臣萬恭之請，予之謚蔭。

translations.literal: " The former minister Song Li managed the Huitong Canal and we still rely on it today; Your Majesty approved Supervisor Wan Gong's request and gave posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: " The former minister Song Li managed the Huitong Canal and we still rely on it today; Your Majesty approved Supervisor Wan Gong's request and gave posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 今季馴功不在禮下，乃當身存之日，使與編戶齒，寧不隳諸臣任事之心，失朝廷報功之典哉！

translations.literal: Now Jixun's achievement is not below Song Li's, yet while he still lives you make him count as a common household—will this not destroy officials' will to serve and lose the court's standard for rewarding merit?
translations.idiomatic: Now Jixun's achievement is not below Song Li's, yet while he still lives you make him count as a common household—will this not destroy officials' will to serve and lose the court's standard for rewarding merit?

sentences.zh: 」御史董子行亦言季馴罪輕責重。

translations.literal: Censor Dong Zixing also said Jixun's punishment was heavy for a light fault.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Dong Zixing also said Jixun's punishment was heavy for a light fault.

sentences.zh: 詔俱奪其俸。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered both to forfeit salary.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered both to forfeit salary.

sentences.zh: 其後論薦者不已。

translations.literal: After that recommendations continued without end.
translations.idiomatic: After that recommendations continued without end.

sentences.zh: 十六年，給事中梅國樓復薦，遂起季馴右都御史，總督河道。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Supervising Secretary Mei Guolou recommended again and Jixun was recalled as right censor-in-chief, supreme commander of the river route.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Supervising Secretary Mei Guolou recommended again and Jixun was recalled as right censor-in-chief, supreme commander of the river route.

sentences.zh: 自吳桂芳後，河漕皆總理，至是復設專官。

translations.literal: After Wu Guifang, river and grain transport had been jointly managed; now a separate post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Guifang, river and grain transport had been jointly managed; now a separate post was restored.

sentences.zh: 明年，黃水暴漲，沖入夏鎮，壞田廬，居民多溺死。

translations.literal: The next year Yellow River water surged, poured into Xiazhen, destroyed fields and houses, and many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Yellow River water surged, poured into Xiazhen, destroyed fields and houses, and many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 季馴復築塞之。

translations.literal: Jixun again built and blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun again built and blocked it.

sentences.zh: 十九年冬，加太子太保、工部尚書兼右都御史。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth winter he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, minister of Works, and concurrent right censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth winter he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, minister of Works, and concurrent right censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 季馴凡四奉治河命，前後二十七年，習知地形險易。

translations.literal: Jixun received river orders four times over twenty-seven years and knew the terrain's hazards and advantages.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun received river orders four times over twenty-seven years and knew the terrain's hazards and advantages.

sentences.zh: 增築設防，置官建閘，下及木石樁埽，綜理纖悉，積勞成病。

translations.literal: He strengthened dikes and defenses, set up offices and locks, down to timber, stone, piles, and fascines—managing every detail until overwork brought illness.
translations.idiomatic: He strengthened dikes and defenses, set up offices and locks, down to timber, stone, piles, and fascines—managing every detail until overwork brought illness.

sentences.zh: 三疏乞休，不允。

translations.literal: Three times he memorialized to retire; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Three times he memorialized to retire; it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 二十年，泗州大水，城中水三尺，患及祖陵。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Sizhou flooded; water in the city was three chi deep and threatened the imperial ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Sizhou flooded; water in the city was three chi deep and threatened the imperial ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 議者或欲開傅寧湖至六合入江，或欲浚周家橋入高、寶諸湖，或欲開壽州瓦埠河以分淮水上流，或欲弛張福堤以泄淮口。

translations.literal: Some proposed opening Funing Lake to Liuhe to enter the Yangtze, dredging Zhoujiaqiao into the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes, opening the Wabu River at Shouzhou to divide the upper Huai, or relaxing the Zhangfu dike to discharge at the Huai mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Some proposed opening Funing Lake to Liuhe to enter the Yangtze, dredging Zhoujiaqiao into the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes, opening the Wabu River at Shouzhou to divide the upper Huai, or relaxing the Zhangfu dike to discharge at the Huai mouth.

sentences.zh: 季馴謂祖陵王氣不宜輕泄，而巡撫周寀、陳於陛、巡按高舉謂周家橋在祖陵後百里，可疏浚，議不合。

translations.literal: Jixun said the tombs' royal qi should not be lightly released; but Grand Coordinators Zhou Cai, Chen Yubing, and Surveillance Commissioner Gao Ju said Zhoujiaqiao was a hundred li behind the tombs and could be dredged—the plans did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun said the tombs' royal qi should not be lightly released; but Grand Coordinators Zhou Cai, Chen Yubing, and Surveillance Commissioner Gao Ju said Zhoujiaqiao was a hundred li behind the tombs and could be dredged—the plans did not agree.

sentences.zh: 都給事中楊其休請允季馴去。

translations.literal: Chief Supervising Secretary Yang Qixiu asked that Jixun be allowed to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Supervising Secretary Yang Qixiu asked that Jixun be allowed to leave.

sentences.zh: 歸三年卒，年七十五。

translations.literal: Three years after returning home he died at seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: Three years after returning home he died at seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 萬恭，字肅卿，南昌人。

translations.literal: Wan Gong, styled Suqing, was a man of Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Gong, styled Suqing, was a native of Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授南京文選主事，歷考功郎中。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal officer of the Nanjing Bureau of Appointments and served as director in the Bureau of Evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal officer of the Nanjing Bureau of Appointments and served as director in the Bureau of Evaluations.

sentences.zh: 壽王喪過南京，中貴欲令朝王妃，恭厲聲曰：「禮不朝後，況妃乎！

translations.literal: When the Prince of Shou's funeral passed Nanjing, inner eunuchs wanted him to pay court to the princess; Gong said sternly: "By ritual one does not pay court to a consort after the ruler, how much less a princess!
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Shou's funeral passed Nanjing, inner eunuchs wanted him to pay court to the princess; Gong said sternly, "By ritual one does not pay court to a consort after the ruler—how much less a princess!

sentences.zh: 」遂止。

translations.literal: " It was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " It was stopped.

sentences.zh: 就遷光祿少卿，入改大理。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then moved to the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then moved to the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，寇逼通州，帝方急兵事。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year bandits threatened Tongzhou and the emperor was urgently concerned with military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year bandits threatened Tongzhou and the emperor was urgently concerned with military affairs.

sentences.zh: 以兵部右侍郎蔡汝楠、協理戎政侍郎喻時不勝任，調之南京，欲代以鄭曉、楊順、葛縉，手詔問徐階。

translations.literal: Thinking Vice Minister of War Cai Runan and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs Yu Shi unfit, he transferred them to Nanjing and wished to replace them with Zheng Xiao, Yang Shun, or Ge Jin, sending a personal edict to ask Xu Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking Vice Minister of War Cai Runan and Vice Commissioner for Military Affairs Yu Shi unfit, he transferred them to Nanjing and wished to replace them with Zheng Xiao, Yang Shun, or Ge Jin, sending a personal edict to ask Xu Jie.

sentences.zh: 階以曉文士，順、縉匪人，請命吏部推擇。

translations.literal: Jie said Xiao was a literary man and Shun and Jin were unworthy men; he asked the Ministry of Personnel to select.
translations.idiomatic: Jie said Xiao was a literary man and Shun and Jin were unworthy men; he asked the Ministry of Personnel to select.

sentences.zh: 帝乃諭尚書嚴訥越格求之，遂以湖廣參政李燧代時，而命恭代汝楠。

translations.literal: The emperor then told Minister Yan Na to seek beyond normal rules; Li Sui of Huguang was made to replace Shi, and Gong was ordered to replace Runan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then told Minister Yan Na to seek beyond normal rules; Li Sui of Huguang was made to replace Shi, and Gong was ordered to replace Runan.

sentences.zh: 恭列上選兵、議將、練兵車、火器諸事，皆報可。

translations.literal: Gong listed selecting troops, discussing generals, drilling war carts, and firearms; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gong listed selecting troops, discussing generals, drilling war carts, and firearms; all were approved.

sentences.zh: 明年，燧罷，眾將推恭，恭引疾。

translations.literal: The next year Sui was dismissed; the generals recommended Gong but Gong cited illness.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Sui was dismissed; the generals recommended Gong but Gong cited illness.

sentences.zh: 及用趙炳然，恭起視事。

translations.literal: When Zhao Bingran was appointed, Gong took up his duties.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Bingran was appointed, Gong took up his duties.

sentences.zh: 於是給事中胡應嘉劾恭奸欺。

translations.literal: Then Supervising Secretary Hu Yingjia impeached Gong for deceit.
translations.idiomatic: Then Supervising Secretary Hu Yingjia impeached Gong for deceit.

sentences.zh: 恭奏辯，部議調恭。

translations.literal: Gong memorialized in defense; the ministry proposed transferring Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Gong memorialized in defense; the ministry proposed transferring Gong.

sentences.zh: 詔勿問。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that it not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that it not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 恭不自安，力請劇邊自效。

translations.literal: Gong was uneasy and strongly asked to serve on a dangerous frontier himself.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was uneasy and strongly asked to serve on a dangerous frontier himself.

sentences.zh: 乃命兼僉都御史，巡撫山西。

translations.literal: He was ordered as concurrent vice censor-in-chief, grand coordinator of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered as concurrent vice censor-in-chief, grand coordinator of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甫至，寇犯龍須墩，恭伏兵擊卻之。

translations.literal: As soon as he arrived, bandits attacked Longxudun and Gong ambushed and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as he arrived, bandits attacked Longxudun and Gong ambushed and repelled them.

sentences.zh: 未幾，寇五萬騎至朔州川，恭與戰老高墓。

translations.literal: Before long fifty thousand mounted bandits reached Shuozhou plain; Gong fought them at Laogao Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Before long fifty thousand mounted bandits reached Shuozhou plain; Gong fought them at Laogao Tomb.

sentences.zh: 列車為陣，發火器，寇少卻。

translations.literal: He arrayed war carts in formation and fired firearms; the bandits retreated slightly.
translations.idiomatic: He arrayed war carts in formation and fired firearms; the bandits retreated slightly.

sentences.zh: 忽風起，火反焚車，寇復大至。

translations.literal: Suddenly the wind rose and fire burned back into the carts; the bandits came again in force.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly the wind rose and fire burned back into the carts; the bandits came again in force.

sentences.zh: 諸將殊死戰，寇乃去。

translations.literal: The generals fought to the death and the bandits then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The generals fought to the death and the bandits then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When word came, he was rewarded with silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: When word came, he was rewarded with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 巡撫故無旗牌，恭請得之。

translations.literal: Grand coordinators originally had no signal boards; Gong asked and obtained them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinators originally had no signal boards; Gong asked and obtained them.

sentences.zh: 濱河州縣患套寇東掠，歲鑿冰以防，恭為築墻四十里。

translations.literal: River-border prefectures and counties suffered Tatar raids from the east; each year they cut ice as defense; Gong built a wall forty li long.
translations.idiomatic: River-border prefectures and counties suffered Tatar raids from the east; each year they cut ice as defense; Gong built a wall forty li long.

sentences.zh: 教人以耕及用水車法，民大利之。

translations.literal: He taught people farming and the water-wheel method; the people greatly benefited.
translations.idiomatic: He taught people farming and the water-wheel method; the people greatly benefited.

sentences.zh: 浹歲，以內艱歸。

translations.literal: After less than a year he returned on inner mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: After less than a year he returned on inner mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，給事中岑用賓等拾遺及恭。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing, Supervising Secretary Cen Yongbin and others included Gong in remonstrance memorials.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longqing, Supervising Secretary Cen Yongbin and others included Gong in remonstrance memorials.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書楊博議，仍用之邊方。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Yang Bo proposed still using him on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Yang Bo proposed still using him on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 暨服闋，恭遂不出。

translations.literal: When mourning ended Gong did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended Gong did not come out.

sentences.zh: 六年春，給事中劉伯燮薦恭異才。

translations.literal: In the sixth spring Supervising Secretary Liu Boxie recommended Gong as exceptional talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth spring Supervising Secretary Liu Boxie recommended Gong as exceptional talent.

sentences.zh: 會河決邳州，運道大阻，已遣尚書朱衡經理，復命恭以故官總理河道。

translations.literal: When the river burst at Pizhou and the transport route was badly blocked, Minister Zhu Heng had already been sent to manage it; Gong was again ordered in his former post as supreme commissioner of the river route.
translations.idiomatic: When the river burst at Pizhou and the transport route was badly blocked, Minister Zhu Heng had already been sent to manage it; Gong was again ordered in his former post as supreme commissioner of the river route.

sentences.zh: 恭與衡築長堤，北自磨臍溝迄邳州直河，南自離林迄宿遷小河口，各延三百七十里。
