translations.literal: Gong and Heng built long dikes from Mojigou north to the Zhih River at Pizhou, and from Lilin south to the Xiaohekou at Suqian, each extending 370 li.
translations.idiomatic: Gong and Heng built long dikes from Mojigou north to the Zhih River at Pizhou, and from Lilin south to the Xiaohekou at Suqian, each extending 370 li.

sentences.zh: 費帑金三萬，六十日而成。

translations.literal: It cost 30,000 taels of treasury silver and was finished in sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: It cost 30,000 taels of treasury silver and was finished in sixty days.

sentences.zh: 高、寶諸河，夏秋泛濫，歲議增堤，而水益漲。

translations.literal: The Gaoyou and Baoying rivers flooded in summer and autumn; each year they debated raising dikes but the water rose higher.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaoyou and Baoying rivers flooded in summer and autumn; each year they debated raising dikes but the water rose higher.

sentences.zh: 恭緣堤建平水閘二十余，以時泄蓄，專令浚湖，不復增堤，河遂無患。

translations.literal: Gong built more than twenty level-water locks along the dikes to store and release by season, ordering only lake dredging and no more dike-raising; the rivers were then untroubled.
translations.idiomatic: Gong built more than twenty level-water locks along the dikes to store and release by season, ordering only lake dredging and no more dike-raising; the rivers were then untroubled.

sentences.zh: 恭強毅敏達，一時稱才臣。

translations.literal: Gong was forceful, resolute, and quick-witted; for a time he was called a talented minister.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was forceful, resolute, and quick-witted; for a time he was called a talented minister.

sentences.zh: 治水三年，言者劾其不職，竟罷歸。

translations.literal: After three years managing water, critics impeached him for incompetence and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: After three years managing water, critics impeached him for incompetence and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 家居垂二十年卒。

translations.literal: He lived at home nearly twenty years and died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home nearly twenty years and died.

sentences.zh: 孫燝，自有傳。

translations.literal: His grandson Can has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Can has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 吳桂芳，字子實，新建人。

translations.literal: Wu Guifang, styled Zishi, was a man of Xinjian.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Guifang, styled Zishi, was a native of Xinjian.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授刑部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 有崔鑒者，年十三，忿父妾淩母，手刃之。

translations.literal: There was a Cui Jian, thirteen years old, who because his father's concubine bullied his mother killed her with his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Cui Jian, thirteen years old, who because his father's concubine bullied his mother killed her with his own hand.

sentences.zh: 桂芳為著論擬赦。

translations.literal: Guifang wrote a treatise proposing pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang wrote a treatise proposing pardon.

sentences.zh: 尚書聞淵曰：「此董仲舒《春秋》斷獄，柳子厚《復讎議》也。

translations.literal: Minister Wen Yuan said: "This is Dong Zhongshu's Spring and Autumn adjudication and Liu Zongyuan's 'On Revenge'.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wen Yuan said, "This is Dong Zhongshu's Spring and Autumn adjudication and Liu Zongyuan's 'On Revenge'.

sentences.zh: 鑒遂得宥。

translations.literal: Jian was then pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Jian was then pardoned.

sentences.zh: 及淵入吏部，欲任以言職。

translations.literal: When Yuan entered the Ministry of Personnel he wished to appoint Guifang to a remonstrance post.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan entered the Ministry of Personnel he wished to appoint Guifang to a remonstrance post.

sentences.zh: 會聞繼母病，遽請歸，留之不可。

translations.literal: When he heard his stepmother was ill he abruptly asked to return; they could not keep him.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard his stepmother was ill he abruptly asked to return; they could not keep him.

sentences.zh: 起補禮部，歷遷揚州知府。

translations.literal: He was recalled to Rites and rose to prefect of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to Rites and rose to prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 禦倭有功，遷俸一級。

translations.literal: He had merit resisting the wokou and was promoted one rank in salary.
translations.idiomatic: He had merit resisting the wokou and was promoted one rank in salary.

sentences.zh: 又建議增築外城。

translations.literal: He also proposed enlarging and building the outer city wall.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed enlarging and building the outer city wall.

sentences.zh: 揚有二城，自桂芳始。

translations.literal: Yangzhou had two walled cities, beginning with Guifang.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou had two walled cities, beginning with Guifang.

sentences.zh: 歷浙江左布政使，進右僉都御史，巡撫福建。

translations.literal: He served as left provincial administration commissioner of Zhejiang, was promoted to right assistant censor-in-chief, and toured Fujian as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: He served as left provincial administration commissioner of Zhejiang, was promoted to right assistant censor-in-chief, and toured Fujian as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 父喪歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 起故官，撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: Recalled to his former post, he pacified and governed Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to his former post, he pacified and governed Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 尋進右副都御史總理河道，未任。

translations.literal: Soon promoted to right vice censor-in-chief to oversee the river route, but he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon promoted to right vice censor-in-chief to oversee the river route, but he did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督張臬以非軍旅才被劾罷，部議罷總督，改桂芳兵部右侍郎兼右僉都御史，提督兩廣軍務兼理巡撫。

translations.literal: The Liangguang governor-general Zhang Nie was impeached and dismissed for lacking military talent; the ministry proposed abolishing the governor-generalship and appointed Guifang vice minister of War with concurrent right assistant censor-in-chief to direct Liangguang military affairs while also handling grand coordination.
translations.idiomatic: The Liangguang governor-general Zhang Nie was impeached and dismissed for lacking military talent; the ministry proposed abolishing the governor-generalship and appointed Guifang vice minister of War with concurrent right assistant censor-in-chief to direct Liangguang military affairs while also handling grand coordination.

sentences.zh: 兩廣群盜河源李亞元、程鄉葉丹樓連歲為患，潮州舊倭屯據鄒塘。

translations.literal: Bandits in Liangguang—Li Yayuan of Heyuan and Ye Danlou of Chengxiang—had plagued the region for years, and old wokou in Chaozhou were encamped at Zoutang.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Liangguang—Li Yayuan of Heyuan and Ye Danlou of Chengxiang—had plagued the region for years, and old wokou in Chaozhou were encamped at Zoutang.

sentences.zh: 桂芳先討倭。

translations.literal: Guifang attacked the wokou first.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang attacked the wokou first.

sentences.zh: 以降賊伍端為前驅，官軍繼進，一日夜克三巢，焚斬四百余人。

translations.literal: Using the surrendered bandit Wu Duan as vanguard, government troops followed; in one day and night they took three lairs, burning and beheading more than four hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Using the surrendered bandit Wu Duan as vanguard, government troops followed; in one day and night they took three lairs, burning and beheading more than four hundred men.

sentences.zh: 帝深嘉之，令與南贛提督吳百朋乘勝滅賊。

translations.literal: The emperor greatly commended him and ordered him to join Nan'gan supervising censor Wu Baipeng in pressing the victory to exterminate the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor greatly commended him and ordered him to join Nan'gan supervising censor Wu Baipeng in pressing the victory to exterminate the bandits.

sentences.zh: 而新倭寇福建省為戚繼光所敗，流入境。

translations.literal: Meanwhile new wokou defeated in Fujian by Qi Jiguang flowed into the territory.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile new wokou defeated in Fujian by Qi Jiguang flowed into the territory.

sentences.zh: 桂芳、百朋會調土、漢兵，乘其初至，急擊之。

translations.literal: Guifang and Baipeng jointly mobilized native and Han troops and, striking while the enemy had just arrived, attacked urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang and Baipeng jointly mobilized native and Han troops and, striking while the enemy had just arrived, attacked urgently.

sentences.zh: 倭懼，悉奔甲子崎沙，奪漁舟入海。

translations.literal: The wokou in fear all fled to Jiaziqi Beach, seized fishing boats, and put to sea.
translations.idiomatic: The wokou in fear all fled to Jiaziqi Beach, seized fishing boats, and put to sea.

sentences.zh: 暴風起，皆覆溺死。

translations.literal: A violent storm arose and all were capsized and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: A violent storm arose and all were capsized and drowned.

sentences.zh: 脫者還海豐，副總兵湯克寬擒斬殆盡。

translations.literal: Those who escaped returned to Haifeng; deputy commander Tang Kekuan captured and beheaded nearly all of them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who escaped returned to Haifeng; deputy commander Tang Kekuan captured and beheaded nearly all of them.

sentences.zh: 因建議海道副使轄東莞以西至瓊州，領番夷市舶，更設海防僉事，巡東莞以東至惠潮，專禦倭寇。

translations.literal: He therefore proposed that the maritime-route vice commissioner govern from Dongguan westward to Qiongzhou, overseeing foreign trade ships, and that a separate maritime-defense intendant be established to patrol from Dongguan eastward to Huizhou and Chaozhou, devoted solely to repelling wokou.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore proposed that the maritime-route vice commissioner govern from Dongguan westward to Qiongzhou, overseeing foreign trade ships, and that a separate maritime-defense intendant be established to patrol from Dongguan eastward to Huizhou and Chaozhou, devoted solely to repelling wokou.

sentences.zh: 又進討亞元、丹樓，平之。

translations.literal: He then advanced to attack Yayuan and Danlou and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: He then advanced to attack Yayuan and Danlou and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 降賊王西橋、吳平已撫復叛。

translations.literal: Surrendered bandits Wang Xiqiao and Wu Ping, having been pacified, rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered bandits Wang Xiqiao and Wu Ping, having been pacified, rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 西橋掠東莞，敗都指揮劉世恩兵，執肇慶同知郭文通以求撫。

translations.literal: Xiqiao raided Dongguan, defeated the troops of regional commander Liu Shi'en, and seized Zhaoqing sub-prefect Guo Wentong to demand pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Xiqiao raided Dongguan, defeated the troops of regional commander Liu Shi'en, and seized Zhaoqing sub-prefect Guo Wentong to demand pacification.

sentences.zh: 桂芳擒斬之，進討平。

translations.literal: Guifang captured and executed him, then advanced against Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang captured and executed him, then advanced against Ping.

sentences.zh: 平初據南澳，為戚繼光、俞大猷所敗，奔饒平鳳凰山，掠民舟出海，自陽江奔安南。

translations.literal: Ping had first held Nan'ao, was defeated by Qi Jiguang and Yu Dayou, fled to Fenghuang Mountain in Raoping, plundered civilian boats to go to sea, and from Yangjiang fled to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Ping had first held Nan'ao, was defeated by Qi Jiguang and Yu Dayou, fled to Fenghuang Mountain in Raoping, plundered civilian boats to go to sea, and from Yangjiang fled to Annam.

sentences.zh: 桂芳檄安南萬寧宣撫司進剿，遣克寬以舟師會之，夾擊平萬橋山下。

translations.literal: Guifang ordered the Wanning pacification commission of Annam to advance in suppression, sent Kekuan with a fleet to join them, and attacked Ping from both sides below Wanqiao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang ordered the Wanning pacification commission of Annam to advance in suppression, sent Kekuan with a fleet to join them, and attacked Ping from both sides below Wanqiao Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乘風縱火，平軍死無算，擒斬三百九十余人。

translations.literal: Riding the wind they set fires; Ping's army suffered immeasurable deaths, and more than three hundred ninety were captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Riding the wind they set fires; Ping's army suffered immeasurable deaths, and more than three hundred ninety were captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 參將傅應嘉言平已擒，後復雲溺死。

translations.literal: Regional vice commander Fu Yingjia reported that Ping had been captured, but later again claimed he had drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Regional vice commander Fu Yingjia reported that Ping had been captured, but later again claimed he had drowned.

sentences.zh: 福建巡撫汪道昆奏聞，桂芳不肯，曰：「風火交熾時，何以知其必死也？

translations.literal: Fujian grand coordinator Wang Daokun memorialized the throne; Guifang refused, saying: "When wind and fire blazed together, how could one know he must have died?
translations.idiomatic: Fujian grand coordinator Wang Daokun memorialized the throne; Guifang refused, saying, "When wind and fire blazed together, how could one know he must have died?

sentences.zh: 」平黨林道乾復窺南澳，時議設參將戍守。

translations.literal: " Ping's follower Lin Daoqian again eyed Nan'ao, and at the time there was discussion of posting a regional vice commander to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: " Ping's follower Lin Daoqian again eyed Nan'ao, and at the time there was discussion of posting a regional vice commander to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 桂芳言：「澳中地險而腴。

translations.literal: Guifang said: "The land in the bay is strategically perilous yet fertile.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang said, "The land in the bay is strategically perilous yet fertile.

sentences.zh: 元時曾設兵戍守，戍兵即據以叛，此禦盜生盜也，不如戍柘林便。

translations.literal: In Yuan times troops were posted to garrison it and the garrison troops promptly seized it to rebel—this is using thieves to guard against thieves; it would be better to garrison Zhelin.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan times troops were posted to garrison it and the garrison troops promptly seized it to rebel—this is using thieves to guard against thieves; it would be better to garrison Zhelin.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved.

sentences.zh: 召為南京兵部右侍郎，尋改北部。

translations.literal: He was summoned as right vice minister of War at Nanjing, soon transferred to the northern ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as right vice minister of War at Nanjing, soon transferred to the northern ministry.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，轉左，以疾乞歸。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he transferred to the left post and asked to retire on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longqing he transferred to the left post and asked to retire on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 言官數論薦。

translations.literal: Remonstrating officials repeatedly recommended him in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating officials repeatedly recommended him in memorials.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三年冬，即家起故官，總督漕運兼巡撫鳳陽。

translations.literal: In the winter of Wanli year 3 he was recalled from home to his former post as grain-transport governor-general concurrent Fengyang grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Wanli year 3 he was recalled from home to his former post as grain-transport governor-general concurrent Fengyang grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 明年春，桂芳以淮、揚洪潦奔流，惟云梯關一徑入海，致海湧橫沙，河流泛溢，而興、鹽、高、寶諸州縣所在受災，請益開草灣及老黃河故道以廣入海之路，修築高郵東西二堤以蓄湖水。

translations.literal: The next spring Guifang, because floods in Huai and Yang surged unchecked and only the Yuntiliguan route led to the sea, causing tidal surges and shifting sand and rivers to overflow, with Xing, Yan, Gao, and Bao prefectures and counties all suffering disaster, requested further opening of Caowan and the old Yellow River channel to widen the route to the sea and building east and west dikes at Gaoyou to store lake water.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring Guifang, because floods in Huai and Yang surged unchecked and only the Yuntiliguan route led to the sea, causing tidal surges and shifting sand and rivers to overflow, with Xing, Yan, Gao, and Bao prefectures and counties all suffering disaster, requested further opening of Caowan and the old Yellow River channel to widen the route to the sea and building east and west dikes at Gaoyou to store lake water.

sentences.zh: 皆下所司議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the relevant offices for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the relevant offices for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 未幾，草灣河工告成。

translations.literal: Before long the Caowan river works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Caowan river works were completed.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，河決曹縣、徐州、桃源，給事中劉鉉疏議漕河，語侵桂芳。

translations.literal: That autumn the river breached at Caoxian, Xuzhou, and Taoyuan; supervising secretary Liu Xuan memorialized on the grain route, with words impugning Guifang.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river breached at Caoxian, Xuzhou, and Taoyuan; supervising secretary Liu Xuan memorialized on the grain route, with words impugning Guifang.

sentences.zh: 桂芳疏辯曰：「草灣之開，以高、寶水患沖嚙，疏以拯之，非能使上遊亦不復漲也。

translations.literal: Guifang memorialized in defense, saying: "The opening of Caowan was because Gao and Bao suffered flood damage and erosion; it was dredged to rescue them—it could not keep the upper reaches from rising again.
translations.idiomatic: Guifang memorialized in defense, saying, "The opening of Caowan was because Gao and Bao suffered flood damage and erosion; it was dredged to rescue them—it could not keep the upper reaches from rising again.

sentences.zh: 今山陽以南諸州縣，水落布種，鬥米四分，則臣斯舉亦既得策矣。

translations.literal: Now in the prefectures and counties south of Shanyang, as the water receded they sowed seed and a dou of rice cost four fen—then my measure has already achieved its aim.
translations.idiomatic: Now in the prefectures and counties south of Shanyang, as the water receded they sowed seed and a dou of rice cost four fen—then my measure has already achieved its aim.

sentences.zh: 若徐、邳以上，非臣所屬，臣何與焉。

translations.literal: As for Xu and Pi and above, that is not within my jurisdiction—what have I to do with it?
translations.idiomatic: As for Xu and Pi and above, that is not within my jurisdiction—what have I to do with it?

sentences.zh: 」因請罷。

translations.literal: " He therefore asked to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore asked to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 御史邵陛言：「諸臣以河漲歸咎草灣，阻任事氣，乞策勵桂芳，益底厥績，而詰責河臣傅希摯曠職。

translations.literal: Censor Shao Bi said: "The various officials blame Caowan for the river's rise, dampening the spirit of those who take on tasks; I beg encouragement for Guifang to complete his achievements, and censure river-route minister Fu Xizhi for neglect of duty.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Shao Bi said, "The various officials blame Caowan for the river's rise, dampening the spirit of those who take on tasks; I beg encouragement for Guifang to complete his achievements, and censure river-route minister Fu Xizhi for neglect of duty.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved.

sentences.zh: 其明年，希摯議塞崔鎮決口，束水歸漕，而桂芳欲沖刷成河以為老黃河入海之道。

translations.literal: The next year Xizhi proposed blocking the breach at Cuizhen to confine water to the grain route, while Guifang wanted to scour and form a channel as the old Yellow River route to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Xizhi proposed blocking the breach at Cuizhen to confine water to the grain route, while Guifang wanted to scour and form a channel as the old Yellow River route to the sea.

sentences.zh: 廷議以二人意見不合，改希摯撫陜西，以李世達代。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that the two men's views did not agree; Xizhi was transferred to grand coordinator of Shaanxi and Li Shida replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Court deliberation held that the two men's views did not agree; Xizhi was transferred to grand coordinator of Shaanxi and Li Shida replaced him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，又改世達他任，命桂芳兼理河漕。

translations.literal: Before long Shida was again transferred elsewhere and Guifang was ordered to manage river and grain transport concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Shida was again transferred elsewhere and Guifang was ordered to manage river and grain transport concurrently.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，詔進工部尚書兼右副都御史，居職如故。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 6 an edict promoted him to minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief, his duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 6 an edict promoted him to minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief, his duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 未逾月，卒。

translations.literal: In less than a month he died.
translations.idiomatic: In less than a month he died.

sentences.zh: 尋以高郵湖堤成，贈太子少保。

translations.literal: Soon, because the Gaoyou lake dikes were completed, he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because the Gaoyou lake dikes were completed, he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 傅希摯，衡水人。

translations.literal: Fu Xizhi was a man of Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xizhi was a native of Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 累官右僉都御史，巡撫山東。

translations.literal: Through successive posts he rose to right assistant censor-in-chief and toured Shandong as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive posts he rose to right assistant censor-in-chief and toured Shandong as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 隆慶末，戶部以餉乏議裁山東、河南民兵，希摯爭之而止。

translations.literal: At the end of Longqing the Ministry of Revenue, because supplies were short, proposed cutting militia in Shandong and Henan; Xizhi argued against it and the plan stopped.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Longqing the Ministry of Revenue, because supplies were short, proposed cutting militia in Shandong and Henan; Xizhi argued against it and the plan stopped.

sentences.zh: 改總理河道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to oversee the river route.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to oversee the river route.

sentences.zh: 以茶城淤塞，開梁山以下寧洋山，出右洪口。

translations.literal: Because Chacheng was silted, he opened from below Liangshan through Ningyang Mountain, exiting at Youhongkou.
translations.idiomatic: Because Chacheng was silted, he opened from below Liangshan through Ningyang Mountain, exiting at Youhongkou.

sentences.zh: 萬歷五年，進右副都御史，巡撫陜西。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 5 he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 5 he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 已遷戶部右侍郎，坐隴右礦賊未靖，論罷。

translations.literal: Already transferred to right vice minister of Revenue, he was dismissed on grounds that bandits in Longyou mines were not yet pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Already transferred to right vice minister of Revenue, he was dismissed on grounds that bandits in Longyou mines were not yet pacified.

sentences.zh: 起總督漕運，歷南京戶、兵二部尚書。

translations.literal: Recalled as grain-transport governor-general, he served successively as minister of Revenue and minister of War at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled as grain-transport governor-general, he served successively as minister of Revenue and minister of War at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 召理戎政，以老被劾。

translations.literal: Summoned to manage military affairs, he was impeached on grounds of age.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to manage military affairs, he was impeached on grounds of age.

sentences.zh: 加太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: Granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired.

sentences.zh: 王宗沐，字新甫，臨海人。

translations.literal: Wang Zongmu, styled Xinfu, was a man of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongmu, styled Xinfu, was a native of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Jiajing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授刑部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 與同官李攀龍、王世貞輩，以詩文相友善。

translations.literal: With fellow officials Li Panlong, Wang Shizhen, and others he was on friendly terms through poetry and prose.
translations.idiomatic: With fellow officials Li Panlong, Wang Shizhen, and others he was on friendly terms through poetry and prose.

sentences.zh: 宗沐尤習吏治。

translations.literal: Zongmu was especially versed in administrative governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmu was especially versed in administrative governance.

sentences.zh: 歷江西提學副使。

translations.literal: He served as educational intendant of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational intendant of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 修白鹿洞書院，引諸生講習其中。

translations.literal: He restored Bailudong Academy and gathered students there for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: He restored Bailudong Academy and gathered students there for instruction.

sentences.zh: 三遷山西右布政使。

translations.literal: Through three promotions he became right provincial administration commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Through three promotions he became right provincial administration commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 所部歲祲，宗沐因入覲上疏曰：「山西列郡俱荒，太原尤甚。

translations.literal: His jurisdiction suffered famine year after year; Zongmu therefore on audience memorialized, saying: "Every prefecture in Shanxi is desolate, Taiyuan most of all.
translations.idiomatic: His jurisdiction suffered famine year after year; Zongmu therefore on audience memorialized, saying, "Every prefecture in Shanxi is desolate, Taiyuan most of all.

sentences.zh: 三年於茲，百餘里不聞雞聲。

translations.literal: For three years now, for more than a hundred li one hears no cockcrow.
translations.idiomatic: For three years now, for more than a hundred li one hears no cockcrow.

sentences.zh: 父子夫婦互易一飽，命曰『人市』。

translations.literal: Fathers and sons, husbands and wives exchanged one another for a full belly—the market was called the 'human market'.
translations.idiomatic: Fathers and sons, husbands and wives exchanged one another for a full belly—the market was called the 'human market'.

sentences.zh: 宗祿八十五萬，累歲缺支，饑疫死者幾二百人。

translations.literal: Stipends for the imperial clan totaled eight hundred fifty thousand, unpaid for years; hunger and plague killed nearly two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Stipends for the imperial clan totaled eight hundred fifty thousand, unpaid for years; hunger and plague killed nearly two hundred.

sentences.zh: 夫山西京師右掖，自故關出真定，自忻、代出紫荊，皆不過三日。

translations.literal: Shanxi is the right arm of the capital; from Guguan one reaches Zhending, from Xin and Dai one exits Zijing—all within three days.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi is the right arm of the capital; from Guguan one reaches Zhending, from Xin and Dai one exits Zijing—all within three days.

sentences.zh: 宣、大之糧雖派各郡，而運本色者皆在太原。

translations.literal: Though grain for Xuan and Da was apportioned among the prefectures, those transporting actual grain all did so at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Though grain for Xuan and Da was apportioned among the prefectures, those transporting actual grain all did so at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 饑民一聚，蹂踐劫奪，歲供宣、大兩鎮六十七萬餉，誰為之辦？

translations.literal: Once starving people gather, they trample, rob, and plunder—the annual supply of six hundred seventy thousand for the two garrisons of Xuan and Da, who will provide it?
translations.idiomatic: Once starving people gather, they trample, rob, and plunder—the annual supply of six hundred seventy thousand for the two garrisons of Xuan and Da, who will provide it?

sentences.zh: 此可深念者一也。

translations.literal: This is the first matter deserving deep thought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first matter deserving deep thought.

sentences.zh: 四方奏水旱者以十分上，部議常裁而為三，所免不過存留者而已。

translations.literal: Memorials on flood and drought from all quarters report ten parts in full; the ministry's deliberation usually cuts them to three—the exemption is no more than what is retained locally.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials on flood and drought from all quarters report ten parts in full; the ministry's deliberation usually cuts them to three—the exemption is no more than what is retained locally.

sentences.zh: 今山西所謂存留者，二鎮三關之輸也。

translations.literal: What Shanxi calls retained is the tribute for the two garrisons and three passes.
translations.idiomatic: What Shanxi calls retained is the tribute for the two garrisons and three passes.

sentences.zh: 存留乃反急於起運，是山西終不蒙分毫之寬。

translations.literal: Retained goods are instead more urgently forwarded than transported tribute—thus Shanxi never receives the slightest relief.
translations.idiomatic: Retained goods are instead more urgently forwarded than transported tribute—thus Shanxi never receives the slightest relief.

sentences.zh: 此可深念者二也。

translations.literal: This is the second matter deserving deep thought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the second matter deserving deep thought.

sentences.zh: 開疆萬山之中，巖阻巉絕，太原民不得至澤、潞，安望就食他所？

translations.literal: Opening territory amid ten thousand mountains, cliffs steep and paths cut off, Taiyuan people cannot reach Ze and Lu—how can they hope to seek food elsewhere?
translations.idiomatic: Opening territory amid ten thousand mountains, cliffs steep and paths cut off, Taiyuan people cannot reach Ze and Lu—how can they hope to seek food elsewhere?

sentences.zh: 獨真定米稍可通。

translations.literal: Only Zhending rice can somewhat be brought through.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhending rice can somewhat be brought through.

sentences.zh: 然背負車運，率二鬥而致一斗，甫至壽陽，則價已三倍矣。

translations.literal: Yet carried on the back or by cart, on average two dou yield one dou delivered; by the time it reaches Shouyang the price has already tripled.
translations.idiomatic: Yet carried on the back or by cart, on average two dou yield one dou delivered; by the time it reaches Shouyang the price has already tripled.

sentences.zh: 是可深念者三也。

translations.literal: This is the third matter deserving deep thought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third matter deserving deep thought.

sentences.zh: 饑民相聚為盜，招之不可，勢必撲殺。

translations.literal: Starving people gather to become bandits; summoning them does not work—they must inevitably be suppressed and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Starving people gather to become bandits; summoning them does not work—they must inevitably be suppressed and killed.

sentences.zh: 小則支庫金，大則請內帑。

translations.literal: For small cases branch treasury funds; for large ones request funds from the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: For small cases branch treasury funds; for large ones request funds from the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 與其發帑以賞殺盜之人，孰若發帑使不為盜？

translations.literal: Rather than disbursing treasury funds to reward those who kill bandits, is it not better to disburse treasury funds so they do not become bandits?
translations.idiomatic: Rather than disbursing treasury funds to reward those who kill bandits, is it not better to disburse treasury funds so they do not become bandits?

sentences.zh: 此可深念者四也。

translations.literal: This is the fourth matter deserving deep thought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth matter deserving deep thought.

sentences.zh: 近丘富往來誘惑，邊民妄傳募人耕田不取租稅。

translations.literal: Recently Qiu Fu went back and forth enticing; border people falsely spread word that men were recruited to farm fields without rent or tax.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Qiu Fu went back and forth enticing; border people falsely spread word that men were recruited to farm fields without rent or tax.

sentences.zh: 愚民何知，急不暇擇，長邊八百餘里，誰要之者？

translations.literal: What do ignorant people know? In urgent straits they cannot choose—the long border of more than eight hundred li, who wants them?
translations.idiomatic: What do ignorant people know? In urgent straits they cannot choose—the long border of more than eight hundred li, who wants them?

sentences.zh: 彼誘而眾，我逃而虛。

translations.literal: They entice and the crowd grows; we flee and the land is emptied.
translations.idiomatic: They entice and the crowd grows; we flee and the land is emptied.

sentences.zh: 此可深念者五也。

translations.literal: This is the fifth matter deserving deep thought.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fifth matter deserving deep thought.

sentences.zh: 」因請緩征逋賦，留河東新增鹽課以給宗祿。

translations.literal: " He therefore requested deferral of overdue taxes and retention of newly added salt levies east of the river to pay imperial clan stipends.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore requested deferral of overdue taxes and retention of newly added salt levies east of the river to pay imperial clan stipends.

sentences.zh: 尋改廣西左布政使，再補山東。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to left provincial administration commissioner of Guangxi, he was again assigned to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to left provincial administration commissioner of Guangxi, he was again assigned to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年，給事中李貴和請開膠萊河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Longqing supervising secretary Li Guihe requested opening the Jiaolai River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Longqing supervising secretary Li Guihe requested opening the Jiaolai River.

sentences.zh: 宗沐以其功難成，不足濟運，遺書中朝止之。

translations.literal: Zongmu held that the work would be hard to complete and insufficient to aid transport; he sent letters to the court to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmu held that the work would be hard to complete and insufficient to aid transport; he sent letters to the court to stop it.

sentences.zh: 拜右副都御史，總督漕運兼巡撫鳳陽，極陳運軍之苦，請亟優恤。

translations.literal: Appointed right vice censor-in-chief as grain-transport governor-general concurrent Fengyang grand coordinator, he fully described the sufferings of transport troops and urgently requested generous relief.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed right vice censor-in-chief as grain-transport governor-general concurrent Fengyang grand coordinator, he fully described the sufferings of transport troops and urgently requested generous relief.

sentences.zh: 又以河決無常，運者終梗，欲復海運，上疏曰：「自會通河開浚以來，海運不講已久。

translations.literal: Also because river breaches were unpredictable and transport was ultimately obstructed, he wished to restore maritime transport and memorialized, saying: "Since the Huitong River was dredged, maritime transport has long gone unconsidered.
translations.idiomatic: Also because river breaches were unpredictable and transport was ultimately obstructed, he wished to restore maritime transport and memorialized, saying, "Since the Huitong River was dredged, maritime transport has long gone unconsidered.

sentences.zh: 臣近官山東，嘗條斯議。

translations.literal: When I recently served in Shandong I once set forth this proposal.
translations.idiomatic: When I recently served in Shandong I once set forth this proposal.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史梁夢龍毅然試之，底績無壅，而慮者輒苦風波。

translations.literal: Grand coordinator and censor-in-chief Liang Menglong resolutely tried it; the achievement was completed without obstruction, yet those who worried constantly complained of wind and waves.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator and censor-in-chief Liang Menglong resolutely tried it; the achievement was completed without obstruction, yet those who worried constantly complained of wind and waves.

sentences.zh: 夫東南之海，天下眾水之委也，茫渺無山，趨避靡所，近南水暖，蛟龍窟宅。

translations.literal: The sea of the southeast is where all the waters under heaven converge—boundless, without mountains, with nowhere to flee; farther south the water is warm and dragons and serpents make their lairs.
translations.idiomatic: The sea of the southeast is where all the waters under heaven converge—boundless, without mountains, with nowhere to flee; farther south the water is warm and dragons and serpents make their lairs.

sentences.zh: 故元人海運多驚，以其起自太倉、嘉定而北也。

translations.literal: Hence Yuan maritime transport often met with alarm, because it set out from Taicang and Jiading northward.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Yuan maritime transport often met with alarm, because it set out from Taicang and Jiading northward.

sentences.zh: 若自淮安而東，引登、萊以泊天津，是謂北海，中多島嶼，可以避風。

translations.literal: If from Huai'an eastward one leads through Deng and Lai to moor at Tianjin, this is called the North Sea; it has many islands where one can avoid wind.
translations.idiomatic: If from Huai'an eastward one leads through Deng and Lai to moor at Tianjin, this is called the North Sea; it has many islands where one can avoid wind.

sentences.zh: 又其地高而多石，蛟龍有往來而無窟宅。

translations.literal: Moreover the land there is high and stony; dragons and serpents pass through but have no lairs.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the land there is high and stony; dragons and serpents pass through but have no lairs.

sentences.zh: 故登州有海市，以石氣與水氣相搏，映石而成，石氣能達於水面，以石去水近故也。

translations.literal: Hence Dengzhou has the sea mirage—stone vapor and water vapor contend, reflecting stone to form it; stone vapor can reach the water surface because stone is close to water.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Dengzhou has the sea mirage—stone vapor and water vapor contend, reflecting stone to form it; stone vapor can reach the water surface because stone is close to water.

sentences.zh: 北海之淺，是其明驗。

translations.literal: The shallowness of the North Sea is clear proof of this.
translations.idiomatic: The shallowness of the North Sea is clear proof of this.

sentences.zh: 可以佐運河之窮，計無便於此者。

translations.literal: It can assist the grain canal in extremity; no plan is more convenient than this.
translations.idiomatic: It can assist the grain canal in extremity; no plan is more convenient than this.

sentences.zh: 」因條上便宜七事。

translations.literal: " He therefore submitted in detail seven expedient measures.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore submitted in detail seven expedient measures.

sentences.zh: 明年三月遂運米十二萬石自淮入海，五月抵天津。

translations.literal: The next year in the third month they transported one hundred twenty thousand shi of rice from Huai to sea; in the fifth month it reached Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: The next year in the third month they transported one hundred twenty thousand shi of rice from Huai to sea; in the fifth month it reached Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 敘功，與夢龍俱進秩，賜金幣。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded; Zongmu and Menglong were both promoted in rank and granted gold and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Merit was recorded; Zongmu and Menglong were both promoted in rank and granted gold and silks.

sentences.zh: 而南京給事中張煥言：「比聞八舟漂沒，失米三千二百石。

translations.literal: But Nanjing supervising secretary Zhang Huan said: "I have lately heard eight boats were lost in wreck and three thousand two hundred shi of rice lost.
translations.idiomatic: But Nanjing supervising secretary Zhang Huan said, "I have lately heard eight boats were lost in wreck and three thousand two hundred shi of rice lost.

sentences.zh: 宗沐預計有此，私令人糴補。

translations.literal: Zongmu had anticipated this and privately had people purchase grain to make up the loss.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmu had anticipated this and privately had people purchase grain to make up the loss.

sentences.zh: 夫米可補，人命可補乎？

translations.literal: Rice can be made up—can human lives be made up?
translations.idiomatic: Rice can be made up—can human lives be made up?

sentences.zh: 宗沐掩飾視聽，非大臣誼。

translations.literal: Zongmu concealed this from sight and hearing—not the conduct of a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmu concealed this from sight and hearing—not the conduct of a great minister.

sentences.zh: 」宗沐疏辯求勘。

translations.literal: " Zongmu memorialized in defense requesting investigation.
translations.idiomatic: " Zongmu memorialized in defense requesting investigation.

sentences.zh: 詔行前議，習海道以備緩急。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the previous proposal carried out and maritime routes practiced against emergency.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the previous proposal carried out and maritime routes practiced against emergency.

sentences.zh: 未幾，海運至即墨，颶風大作，覆七舟，都給事中賈三近、御史鮑希顏及山東巡撫傅希摯俱言不便，遂寢。

translations.literal: Before long maritime transport reached Jimo; a hurricane arose and seven boats capsized; chief supervising secretary Jia Sanjin, censor Bao Xiyan, and Shandong grand coordinator Fu Xizhi all said it was inconvenient, and the plan was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Before long maritime transport reached Jimo; a hurricane arose and seven boats capsized; chief supervising secretary Jia Sanjin, censor Bao Xiyan, and Shandong grand coordinator Fu Xizhi all said it was inconvenient, and the plan was shelved.

sentences.zh: 時萬歷元年也。

translations.literal: It was Wanli year 1.
translations.idiomatic: It was Wanli year 1.

sentences.zh: 宗沐以徐、邳俗獷悍，多奸猾，濱海鹽徒出沒，六安、霍山礦賊竊發，奏設守將。

translations.literal: Zongmu, because customs in Xu and Pi were fierce and many were cunning, coastal salt smugglers came and went, and bandits in Lu'an and Huoshan mines stole out, memorialized to establish defending generals.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmu, because customs in Xu and Pi were fierce and many were cunning, coastal salt smugglers came and went, and bandits in Lu'an and Huoshan mines stole out, memorialized to establish defending generals.

sentences.zh: 又召豪俠巨室三百余人充義勇，責令捕盜，後多以功給冠帶。

translations.literal: He also summoned more than three hundred bold spirits of great houses to serve as volunteers, charging them to capture bandits; many later received official caps and sashes for merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also summoned more than three hundred bold spirits of great houses to serve as volunteers, charging them to capture bandits; many later received official caps and sashes for merit.

sentences.zh: 遷南京刑部右侍郎，召改工部。

translations.literal: Transferred to right vice minister of Punishments at Nanjing, he was summoned and transferred to Works.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to right vice minister of Punishments at Nanjing, he was summoned and transferred to Works.

sentences.zh: 尋進刑部左侍郎，奉敕閱視宣、大、山西諸鎮邊務。

translations.literal: Soon promoted to left vice minister of Punishments, he received imperial orders to inspect border affairs of the garrisons of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon promoted to left vice minister of Punishments, he received imperial orders to inspect border affairs of the garrisons of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 母喪歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 九年，以京察拾遺罷，不敘。

translations.literal: In year 9, in the capital review of retained officials he was dismissed without reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, in the capital review of retained officials he was dismissed without reassignment.

sentences.zh: 居家十余年卒。

translations.literal: At home for more than ten years he died.
translations.idiomatic: At home for more than ten years he died.

sentences.zh: 贈刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously granted minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，追謚襄裕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously granted the posthumous title Xiangyu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously granted the posthumous title Xiangyu.

sentences.zh: 子士崧、士琦、士昌，從子士性，皆進士。

translations.literal: His sons Shisong, Shiqi, and Shichang and nephew Shixing all became jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Shisong, Shiqi, and Shichang and nephew Shixing all became jinshi.

sentences.zh: 士崧官刑部主事。

translations.literal: Shisong served as principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Shisong served as principal officer in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 士琦歷重慶知府。

translations.literal: Shiqi served successively as prefect of Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqi served successively as prefect of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 播州宣慰使楊應龍叛，承總督邢玠檄至松坎撫定之。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Yang Yinglong of Bozhou rebelled; receiving Governor-general Xing Jie's dispatch he reached Songkan to pacify and settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Yang Yinglong of Bozhou rebelled; receiving Governor-general Xing Jie's dispatch he reached Songkan to pacify and settle them.

sentences.zh: 遂進兵備副使，治其地。

translations.literal: He was then promoted to vice commissioner for military preparedness and governed the region.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to vice commissioner for military preparedness and governed the region.

sentences.zh: 尋以山東參政監軍朝鮮有功，超擢河南右布政使。

translations.literal: Soon, as Shandong administrative commissioner supervising troops in Korea with merit, he was specially promoted to right provincial administration commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, as Shandong administrative commissioner supervising troops in Korea with merit, he was specially promoted to right provincial administration commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 坐應龍復叛，降湖廣右參政。

translations.literal: Because Yinglong rebelled again he was demoted to right administrative commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yinglong rebelled again he was demoted to right administrative commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 歷山東右布政使，佐余宗浚封順義王，進秩賜金。

translations.literal: Serving as right provincial administration commissioner of Shandong he assisted Yu Zongjun in enfeoffing the Prince of Shunyi and was promoted in rank and granted gold.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as right provincial administration commissioner of Shandong he assisted Yu Zongjun in enfeoffing the Prince of Shunyi and was promoted in rank and granted gold.

sentences.zh: 擢右副都御史巡撫大同，被劾擬調。

translations.literal: Promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Datong, he was impeached and slated for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Datong, he was impeached and slated for transfer.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 士昌由龍谿知縣擢兵科給事中。

translations.literal: Shichang rose from magistrate of Longxi to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shichang rose from magistrate of Longxi to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 寇犯固原、甘肅，方議諸將罪，而延綏兩以捷聞。

translations.literal: When bandits invaded Guyuan and Gansu, generals' guilt was under discussion, yet Yan and Sui twice reported victories.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits invaded Guyuan and Gansu, generals' guilt was under discussion, yet Yan and Sui twice reported victories.

sentences.zh: 兵部請告廟宣捷，士昌奏止之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War requested announcing victory at the temple; Shichang memorialized to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War requested announcing victory at the temple; Shichang memorialized to stop it.

sentences.zh: 改禮科。

translations.literal: Transferred to the Bureau of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to the Bureau of Rites.

sentences.zh: 礦稅興，疏言：「近日禦題黃纛，遍布關津；

translations.literal: When the mining tax was instituted he memorialized, saying: "Recently imperial yellow banners were posted everywhere at passes and posts;
translations.idiomatic: When the mining tax was instituted he memorialized, saying, "Recently imperial yellow banners were posted everywhere at passes and posts;

sentences.zh: 聖旨朱牌，委褻蔀屋。

translations.literal: imperial vermilion placards were delegated to humble thatched houses.
translations.idiomatic: imperial vermilion placards were delegated to humble thatched houses.

sentences.zh: 遂使三家之村，雞犬悉盡；

translations.literal: Thus in villages of three households chickens and dogs were all taken;
translations.idiomatic: Thus in villages of three households chickens and dogs were all taken;

sentences.zh: 五都之市，絲粟皆空。

translations.literal: in markets of five capitals silk and grain were all emptied.
translations.idiomatic: in markets of five capitals silk and grain were all emptied.

sentences.zh: 且稅以店名，無異北齊之市肆；

translations.literal: Moreover tax by shop name was no different from Northern Qi market stalls;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover tax by shop name was no different from Northern Qi market stalls;

sentences.zh: 官從內遣，何啻西苑之斜封！

translations.literal: officials dispatched from within—how was it not like the slanting seals of the Western Garden!
translations.idiomatic: officials dispatched from within—how was it not like the slanting seals of the Western Garden!

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No response.
translations.idiomatic: " No response.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，帝將冊立東宮，而故緩其期。

translations.literal: In year 29 the emperor was about to invest the heir apparent but deliberately delayed the date.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 the emperor was about to invest the heir apparent but deliberately delayed the date.

sentences.zh: 士昌偕同官楊天民極諫，謫貴州鎮遠典史。

translations.literal: Shichang together with fellow official Yang Tianmin remonstrated urgently and was demoted to record keeper of Zhenyuan in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shichang together with fellow official Yang Tianmin remonstrated urgently and was demoted to record keeper of Zhenyuan in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 屢遷大理右丞署事，與張問達共定張差獄。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to right vice director of the Court of Judicial Review acting in office, he together with Zhang Wenda settled the Zhang Cha case.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly promoted to right vice director of the Court of Judicial Review acting in office, he together with Zhang Wenda settled the Zhang Cha case.

sentences.zh: 旋進右少卿，擢右僉都御史，巡撫福建。

translations.literal: Soon promoted to right vice director, then to right assistant censor-in-chief touring Fujian as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: Soon promoted to right vice director, then to right assistant censor-in-chief touring Fujian as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 歸卒。

translations.literal: He returned home and died.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home and died.

sentences.zh: 士性，字恒叔，由確山知縣征授禮科給事中。

translations.literal: Shixing, styled Hengshu, was summoned from magistrate of Queshan and appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Shixing, styled Hengshu, was summoned from magistrate of Queshan and appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Rites.

sentences.zh: 首陳天下大計，言朝廷要務二，曰親章奏，節財用；

translations.literal: First he set forth the great plan of the realm, saying the court's essential tasks were two: personally reading memorials and economizing expenditures;
translations.idiomatic: First he set forth the great plan of the realm, saying the court's essential tasks were two: personally reading memorials and economizing expenditures;

sentences.zh: 官司要務三，曰有司文網，督學科條，王官考核；

translations.literal: the essential tasks of officials three: the legal net of local magistrates, examination regulations of educational supervisors, and assessment of civil officials;
translations.idiomatic: the essential tasks of officials three: the legal net of local magistrates, examination regulations of educational supervisors, and assessment of civil officials;

sentences.zh: 兵戎要務四，曰中州武備，晉地要害，北寇機宜，遼左戰功。

translations.literal: the essential tasks of military affairs four: armaments of the central provinces, key points of Jin territory, measures against northern bandits, and achievements in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: the essential tasks of military affairs four: armaments of the central provinces, key points of Jin territory, measures against northern bandits, and achievements in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 疏凡數千言，深切時弊，多議行。

translations.literal: The memorial ran to several thousand words, penetrating the ills of the time; much was deliberated and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial ran to several thousand words, penetrating the ills of the time; much was deliberated and carried out.

sentences.zh: 詔制鰲山燈，未幾，慈寧宮火，士性請停前詔，帝納之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered construction of the Aoshan lanterns; before long Cining Palace burned and Shixing requested stopping the prior edict—the emperor accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered construction of the Aoshan lanterns; before long Cining Palace burned and Shixing requested stopping the prior edict—the emperor accepted it.

sentences.zh: 楊巍議黜丁此呂，士性劾巍阿輔臣申時行，時行納巍邪媚，皆失大臣誼。

translations.literal: Yang Wei proposed dismissing Ding Cilü; Shixing impeached Wei for currying favor with Grand Secretary Shen Shixing, and Shixing for accepting Wei's sycophancy—both failed in the conduct of great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wei proposed dismissing Ding Cilü; Shixing impeached Wei for currying favor with Grand Secretary Shen Shixing, and Shixing for accepting Wei's sycophancy—both failed in the conduct of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 寢不行。

translations.literal: The matter was shelved without action.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was shelved without action.

sentences.zh: 時行，士性座主也。

translations.literal: Shixing was Shen Shixing's examination patron.
translations.idiomatic: Shixing was Shen Shixing's examination patron.

sentences.zh: 久之，疏言：「朝廷用人，不宜專取容身緘默，緩急不足恃者。

translations.literal: After a long time he memorialized, saying: "In employing men the court should not exclusively take those who preserve themselves in silence and cannot be relied on in urgency.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he memorialized, saying, "In employing men the court should not exclusively take those who preserve themselves in silence and cannot be relied on in urgency.

sentences.zh: 請召還沈思孝、吳中行、艾穆、鄒元標、黃道瞻、蔡時鼎、聞道立、顧憲成、孫如法、姜應麟、馬應圖、王德新、盧洪春、彭遵古、諸壽賢、顧允成等。

translations.literal: I request recall of Shen Siliao, Wu Zhongxing, Ai Mu, Zou Yuanbiao, Huang Daozhan, Cai Shiding, Wen Daoli, Gu Xiancheng, Sun Rufa, Jiang Yinglin, Ma Yingtu, Wang Dexin, Lu Hongchun, Peng Zungu, Zhu Shouxian, Gu Yuncheng, and others.
translations.idiomatic: I request recall of Shen Siliao, Wu Zhongxing, Ai Mu, Zou Yuanbiao, Huang Daozhan, Cai Shiding, Wen Daoli, Gu Xiancheng, Sun Rufa, Jiang Yinglin, Ma Yingtu, Wang Dexin, Lu Hongchun, Peng Zungu, Zhu Shouxian, Gu Yuncheng, and others.

sentences.zh: 忤旨，不報。

translations.literal: Contravening the imperial will, no response.
translations.idiomatic: Contravening the imperial will, no response.

sentences.zh: 遷吏科給事中，出為四川參議，歷太仆少卿。

translations.literal: Promoted to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Personnel, he went out as Sichuan administrative commissioner and served as vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Personnel, he went out as Sichuan administrative commissioner and served as vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 河南缺巡撫，廷推首王國，士性次之。

translations.literal: Henan lacked a grand coordinator; court recommendation ranked Wang Guo first and Shixing second.
translations.idiomatic: Henan lacked a grand coordinator; court recommendation ranked Wang Guo first and Shixing second.

sentences.zh: 帝特用士性。

translations.literal: The emperor specially used Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor specially used Shixing.

sentences.zh: 士性疏辭，言資望不及國。

translations.literal: Shixing memorialized declining, saying his seniority did not match Guo.
translations.idiomatic: Shixing memorialized declining, saying his seniority did not match Guo.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其矯，且謂國實使之，遂出國於外，調士性南京。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected pretense and also thought Guo had instigated it; he therefore sent Guo outside and transferred Shixing to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected pretense and also thought Guo had instigated it; he therefore sent Guo outside and transferred Shixing to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 久之，就遷鴻臚卿，卒。

translations.literal: After a long time he was promoted to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and died.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was promoted to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and died.

sentences.zh: 劉東星，字子明，沁水人。

translations.literal: Liu Dongxing, styled Ziming, was a man of Qinshui.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dongxing, styled Ziming, was a native of Qinshui.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年進士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longqing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Longqing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 改庶吉士，授兵科給事中。

translations.literal: Transferred to Hanlin bachelor, he was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Hanlin bachelor, he was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 大學士高拱攝吏部，以非時考察，謫蒲城縣丞。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Gao Gong acting in the Ministry of Personnel, because the review was not at the proper time, demoted him to assistant magistrate of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Gao Gong acting in the Ministry of Personnel, because the review was not at the proper time, demoted him to assistant magistrate of Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 徙盧氏知縣，累遷湖廣左布政使。

translations.literal: Transferred to magistrate of Lushi, he rose through successive posts to left provincial administration commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to magistrate of Lushi, he rose through successive posts to left provincial administration commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十年，擢右僉都御史，巡撫保定。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 20 he was promoted to right assistant censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 20 he was promoted to right assistant censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 時朝鮮以倭難告。

translations.literal: At the time Korea reported distress from wokou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Korea reported distress from wokou.

sentences.zh: 王師調集，悉會天津，而天津、靜海、滄州、河間皆被災。

translations.literal: Imperial troops were mobilized and all gathered at Tianjin, while Tianjin, Jinghai, Cangzhou, and Hejian all suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops were mobilized and all gathered at Tianjin, while Tianjin, Jinghai, Cangzhou, and Hejian all suffered disaster.

sentences.zh: 東星請漕米十萬石平糶，民乃濟。

translations.literal: Dongxing requested one hundred thousand shi of transport grain for fair sale and the people were thereby relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxing requested one hundred thousand shi of transport grain for fair sale and the people were thereby relieved.

sentences.zh: 召為左副都御史。

translations.literal: Summoned as left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned as left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 進吏部右侍郎，以父老請侍養歸，瀕行而父卒。

translations.literal: Promoted to right vice minister of Personnel, he asked to return to serve his aged father; on the eve of departure his father died.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to right vice minister of Personnel, he asked to return to serve his aged father; on the eve of departure his father died.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，河決單之黃堌，運道堙阻，起工部左侍郎兼右僉都御史，總理河漕。

translations.literal: In year 26 the river breached at Huang'gu in Shan; the transport route was blocked; he was recalled as left vice minister of Works with concurrent right assistant censor-in-chief to oversee river and grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 the river breached at Huang'gu in Shan; the transport route was blocked; he was recalled as left vice minister of Works with concurrent right assistant censor-in-chief to oversee river and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 初，尚書潘季馴議開黃河上流，循商、虞而下，歷丁家道口出徐州小浮橋，即元賈魯所浚故道也，朝廷以費巨未果。

translations.literal: Initially Minister Pan Jixun proposed opening the upper Yellow River, following Shang and Yu downward through Dingjiakou to the small pontoon bridge at Xuzhou—the old channel dredged by Jia Lu of Yuan—but the court, because expense was huge, did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Minister Pan Jixun proposed opening the upper Yellow River, following Shang and Yu downward through Dingjiakou to the small pontoon bridge at Xuzhou—the old channel dredged by Jia Lu of Yuan—but the court, because expense was huge, did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 東星即其地開浚。

translations.literal: Dongxing opened and dredged at that place.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxing opened and dredged at that place.

sentences.zh: 起曲裏鋪至三仙臺，抵小浮橋。

translations.literal: From Qulipu to Sanxiantai, reaching the small pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: From Qulipu to Sanxiantai, reaching the small pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 又浚漕渠自徐、邳至宿。

translations.literal: He also dredged the grain canal from Xu and Pi to Su.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged the grain canal from Xu and Pi to Su.

sentences.zh: 計五閱月工竣，費僅十萬。

translations.literal: In five months the work was completed at a cost of only one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In five months the work was completed at a cost of only one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其績，進工部尚書兼右副都御史。

translations.literal: An edict commended his achievement; he was promoted to minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended his achievement; he was promoted to minister of Works with concurrent right vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 明年，渠邵伯、界首二湖。

translations.literal: The next year he dredged the Shaobo and Jieshou lakes.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he dredged the Shaobo and Jieshou lakes.

sentences.zh: 又明年，奉開泇河。

translations.literal: The year after he received orders to open the Si River.
translations.idiomatic: The year after he received orders to open the Si River.

sentences.zh: 泇界滕、嶧間，南通淮、海，引漕甚便。

translations.literal: The Si lies between Teng and Yi, south connecting Huai and sea—drawing the grain route was very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The Si lies between Teng and Yi, south connecting Huai and sea—drawing the grain route was very convenient.

sentences.zh: 前總督翁大立首議開浚，後尚書朱衡、都御史傅希摯復言之。

translations.literal: Former governor-general Weng Dali first proposed opening and dredging; later Minister Zhu Heng and censor-in-chief Fu Xizhi again spoke of it.
translations.idiomatic: Former governor-general Weng Dali first proposed opening and dredging; later Minister Zhu Heng and censor-in-chief Fu Xizhi again spoke of it.

sentences.zh: 朝廷數遣官行視，乞無成畫。

translations.literal: The court repeatedly sent officials to inspect on site, begging without a completed plan.
translations.idiomatic: The court repeatedly sent officials to inspect on site, begging without a completed plan.

sentences.zh: 河臣舒應龍嘗鑿韓莊，工亦中輟。

translations.literal: River-route minister Shu Yinglong once excavated Hanzhuang but the work also halted midway.
translations.idiomatic: River-route minister Shu Yinglong once excavated Hanzhuang but the work also halted midway.

sentences.zh: 東星力任其役。

translations.literal: Dongxing forcefully undertook the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxing forcefully undertook the labor.

sentences.zh: 初議費百二十萬，及工起，費止七萬，而渠已成十之三。

translations.literal: Initial deliberation estimated cost at one million two hundred thousand; once work began cost was only seventy thousand and the channel was already one-third complete.
translations.idiomatic: Initial deliberation estimated cost at one million two hundred thousand; once work began cost was only seventy thousand and the channel was already one-third complete.

sentences.zh: 會有疾，求去。

translations.literal: Then he fell ill and asked to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Then he fell ill and asked to leave.

sentences.zh: 屢旨慰留。

translations.literal: Repeated edicts comforted and retained him.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated edicts comforted and retained him.

sentences.zh: 卒官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 後李化龍循其遺跡，與李三才共成之，漕永便焉。

translations.literal: Later Li Hualong followed his traces and together with Li Sancai completed it; grain transport was forever convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Hualong followed his traces and together with Li Sancai completed it; grain transport was forever convenient.

sentences.zh: 東星性儉約。

translations.literal: Dongxing was frugal and abstemious by nature.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxing was frugal and abstemious by nature.

sentences.zh: 歷官三十年，敝衣蔬食如一日。

translations.literal: Through thirty years of office, worn clothes and plain food were as one day.
translations.idiomatic: Through thirty years of office, worn clothes and plain food were as one day.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，謚莊靖。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously granted the posthumous title Zhuangjing.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi he was posthumously granted the posthumous title Zhuangjing.

sentences.zh: 胡瓚，字伯玉，桐城人。

translations.literal: Hu Zan, styled Boyu, was a man of Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan, styled Boyu, was a native of Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Wanli he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Wanli reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授都水主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal officer in the Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal officer in the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 分司南旺司兼督泉閘，駐濟寧。

translations.literal: As deputy director of Nanwang Office he also supervised spring locks, stationed at Jining.
translations.idiomatic: As deputy director of Nanwang Office he also supervised spring locks, stationed at Jining.

sentences.zh: 泗水所註，瓚修金口壩遏之。

translations.literal: Where the Si River entered, Zan repaired the Jinkou dam to check it.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Si River entered, Zan repaired the Jinkou dam to check it.

sentences.zh: 造舟汶上，為橋於寧陽，民不病涉。

translations.literal: He built boats at Wenshang and made a bridge at Ningyang so the people were not troubled crossing.
translations.idiomatic: He built boats at Wenshang and made a bridge at Ningyang so the people were not troubled crossing.

sentences.zh: 河決黃堌，瓚憂之。

translations.literal: When the river breached at Huang'gu, Zan was troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the river breached at Huang'gu, Zan was troubled.

sentences.zh: 會劉東星來總河漕，瓚與往復論難。

translations.literal: When Liu Dongxing came to oversee river and grain transport, Zan debated back and forth with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Dongxing came to oversee river and grain transport, Zan debated back and forth with him.

sentences.zh: 謂黃堌不杜，勢且易黃而漕；

translations.literal: He said if Huang'gu were not blocked the situation would soon shift the Yellow River and the grain route;
translations.idiomatic: He said if Huang'gu were not blocked the situation would soon shift the Yellow River and the grain route;

sentences.zh: 漕南北七百里，以涓涓之泉，安能運萬千有奇之艘，使及期飛渡？

translations.literal: the grain route ran seven hundred li north and south—how could a trickle of springs move thousands of odd boats and make them fly across on schedule?
translations.idiomatic: the grain route ran seven hundred li north and south—how could a trickle of springs move thousands of odd boats and make them fly across on schedule?

sentences.zh: 贊東星浚賈魯河故道，益治汶、泗間泉數百。

translations.literal: He supported Dongxing in dredging Jia Lu's old channel and further managed several hundred springs between Wen and Si.
translations.idiomatic: He supported Dongxing in dredging Jia Lu's old channel and further managed several hundred springs between Wen and Si.

sentences.zh: 尋源竟委，著《泉河史》上之。

translations.literal: Tracing sources to their ends he wrote the History of the Spring River and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing sources to their ends he wrote the History of the Spring River and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 瓚治泉，一夫浚一泉，各有分地，省其勤惰而賞罰之。

translations.literal: Zan managed springs—one laborer dredged one spring, each with assigned territory; he inspected diligence and laziness and rewarded and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Zan managed springs—one laborer dredged one spring, each with assigned territory; he inspected diligence and laziness and rewarded and punished.

sentences.zh: 冬則養其余力，不征於官。

translations.literal: In winter he maintained their surplus strength without requisition from the government.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he maintained their surplus strength without requisition from the government.

sentences.zh: 以疏浚運道有功，增秩一等。

translations.literal: For merit in dredging the transport route he was promoted one rank in salary.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in dredging the transport route he was promoted one rank in salary.

sentences.zh: 二十七年督修琉璃河橋。

translations.literal: In year 27 he supervised repair of the Liulihe bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he supervised repair of the Liulihe bridge.

sentences.zh: 三年橋成，省費七萬有奇。

translations.literal: In three years the bridge was completed, saving more than seventy thousand in expense.
translations.idiomatic: In three years the bridge was completed, saving more than seventy thousand in expense.

sentences.zh: 累官江西左參政。

translations.literal: Through successive posts he rose to left administrative commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive posts he rose to left administrative commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 予告歸，久之卒。

translations.literal: Granted leave to return home, after a long time he died.
translations.idiomatic: Granted leave to return home, after a long time he died.

sentences.zh: 徐貞明，字孺東，貴溪人。

translations.literal: Xu Zhenming, styled Rudong, was a man of Guixi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhenming, styled Rudong, was a native of Guixi.

sentences.zh: 父九思，見《循吏傳》。

translations.literal: His father Jiusi is treated in the Biographies of Diligent Officials.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jiusi is treated in the Biographies of Diligent Officials.

sentences.zh: 貞明舉隆慶五年進士。

translations.literal: Zhenming passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of the Longqing reign.

sentences.zh: 知浙江山陰縣，敏而有惠。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Shanyin in Zhejiang he was quick-witted and benevolent.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Shanyin in Zhejiang he was quick-witted and benevolent.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三年，征為工科給事中。

translations.literal: In Wanli year 3 he was summoned as supervising secretary in the Bureau of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 3 he was summoned as supervising secretary in the Bureau of Public Works.

sentences.zh: 會御史傅應禎獲罪，貞明入獄調護，坐貶太平府知事。

translations.literal: When censor Fu Yingzhen was punished, Zhenming entered prison to care for him and was demoted to clerk of Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When censor Fu Yingzhen was punished, Zhenming entered prison to care for him and was demoted to clerk of Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十三年，累遷尚寶司丞。

translations.literal: In year 13 he rose through successive posts to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he rose through successive posts to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 初，貞明為給事中，上水利、軍班二議，謂：

translations.literal: Initially when Zhenming was supervising secretary he submitted two proposals on water conservancy and military households, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Initially when Zhenming was supervising secretary he submitted two proposals on water conservancy and military households, saying:

sentences.zh: 神京雄據上遊，兵食宜取之畿甸，今皆仰給東南。

translations.literal: The divine capital sits astride the upper reaches; military grain should be taken from the capital region—now all depend on supply from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: The divine capital sits astride the upper reaches; military grain should be taken from the capital region—now all depend on supply from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 豈西北古稱富強地，不足以實廩而練卒乎？

translations.literal: Can the northwest, anciently called a rich and strong land, truly be insufficient to fill granaries and drill troops?
translations.idiomatic: Can the northwest, anciently called a rich and strong land, truly be insufficient to fill granaries and drill troops?

sentences.zh: 夫賦稅所出，括民脂膏，而軍船夫役之費，常以數石致一石，東南之力竭矣。

translations.literal: Taxes and levies squeeze the people's fat and grease, while military boats and corvée often cost several shi to deliver one shi—the strength of the southeast is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes and levies squeeze the people's fat and grease, while military boats and corvée often cost several shi to deliver one shi—the strength of the southeast is exhausted.

sentences.zh: 又河流多變，運道多梗，竊有隱憂。

translations.literal: Moreover rivers change often and the transport route is often blocked—I have private worry.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover rivers change often and the transport route is often blocked—I have private worry.

sentences.zh: 聞陜西、河南故渠廢堰，在在有之；

translations.literal: I hear old channels and abandoned weirs in Shaanxi and Henan exist everywhere;
translations.idiomatic: I hear old channels and abandoned weirs in Shaanxi and Henan exist everywhere;

sentences.zh: 山東諸泉，引之率可成田；

translations.literal: springs in Shandong, led forth, can mostly become fields;
translations.idiomatic: springs in Shandong, led forth, can mostly become fields;

sentences.zh: 而畿輔諸郡，或支河所經，或澗泉自出，皆足以資灌溉。

translations.literal: and in the capital region's prefectures, whether branch rivers pass through or spring streams issue on their own, all can suffice for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: and in the capital region's prefectures, whether branch rivers pass through or spring streams issue on their own, all can suffice for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 北人未習水利，惟苦水害，不知水害未除，正由水利未興也。

translations.literal: Northerners are unaccustomed to water works—they only suffer from water harm, not knowing that until water harm is removed it is precisely because water works are not developed.
translations.idiomatic: Northerners are unaccustomed to water works—they only suffer from water harm, not knowing that until water harm is removed it is precisely because water works are not developed.

sentences.zh: 蓋水聚之則為害，散之則為利。

translations.literal: When water gathers it becomes harm; when dispersed it becomes benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When water gathers it becomes harm; when dispersed it becomes benefit.

sentences.zh: 今順天、真定、河間諸郡，桑麻之區，半為沮洳，由上流十五河之水惟泄於貓兒一灣，欲其不泛濫而壅塞，勢不能也。

translations.literal: Now in Shuntian, Zhending, and Hejian prefectures, mulberry and hemp districts are half bog and marsh, because the fifteen rivers of the upper reaches all discharge only at Maorwan—wishing them not to overflow and silt up is impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Now in Shuntian, Zhending, and Hejian prefectures, mulberry and hemp districts are half bog and marsh, because the fifteen rivers of the upper reaches all discharge only at Maorwan—wishing them not to overflow and silt up is impossible.

sentences.zh: 今誠於上流疏渠浚溝，引之灌田，以殺水勢，下流多開支河，以泄橫流，其澱之最下者，留以瀦水，稍高者，皆如南人築圩之制，則水利興，水患亦除矣。

translations.literal: Now if truly at the upper reaches channels are dredged and ditches cleared to lead water to irrigate fields and reduce water force, and at the lower reaches many branch rivers are opened to release cross-flow, keeping the lowest silt for storing water and the slightly higher land all in dyke systems like southerners—then water works flourish and water disaster is also removed.
translations.idiomatic: Now if truly at the upper reaches channels are dredged and ditches cleared to lead water to irrigate fields and reduce water force, and at the lower reaches many branch rivers are opened to release cross-flow, keeping the lowest silt for storing water and the slightly higher land all in dyke systems like southerners—then water works flourish and water disaster is also removed.

sentences.zh: 至於永平、灤州抵滄州、慶雲，地皆萑葦，土實膏腴。

translations.literal: As for Yongping and Luanzhou reaching Cangzhou and Qingyun, the land is all reeds and rushes and the soil is truly fertile.
translations.idiomatic: As for Yongping and Luanzhou reaching Cangzhou and Qingyun, the land is all reeds and rushes and the soil is truly fertile.

sentences.zh: 元虞集欲於京東濱海地築塘捍水以成稻田。

translations.literal: Yu Ji of Yuan wished to build dikes on coastal land east of the capital to hold back water and form rice fields.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Ji of Yuan wished to build dikes on coastal land east of the capital to hold back water and form rice fields.

sentences.zh: 若仿集意，招徠南人，俾之耕藝，北起遼海，南濱青齊，皆良田也。

translations.literal: If following Ji's idea one summons southerners to teach them cultivation, from Liaohai in the north to Qing and Qi on the south coast—all would be good fields.
translations.idiomatic: If following Ji's idea one summons southerners to teach them cultivation, from Liaohai in the north to Qing and Qi on the south coast—all would be good fields.

sentences.zh: 宜特簡憲臣，假以事權，毋阻浮議，需以歲月，不取近功。

translations.literal: One should specially select upright officials, lend them authority, not obstruct by empty talk, and need years and months—not seek near-term achievement.
translations.idiomatic: One should specially select upright officials, lend them authority, not obstruct by empty talk, and need years and months—not seek near-term achievement.

sentences.zh: 或撫窮民而給其牛種，或任富室而緩其征科，或選擇健卒分建屯營，或招徠南人許其占籍。

translations.literal: Or comfort the destitute and give them oxen and seed, or charge wealthy households and defer their levies, or select sturdy soldiers to establish garrison farms in divisions, or summon southerners and permit them registered residence.
translations.idiomatic: Or comfort the destitute and give them oxen and seed, or charge wealthy households and defer their levies, or select sturdy soldiers to establish garrison farms in divisions, or summon southerners and permit them registered residence.

sentences.zh: 俟有成績，次及河南、山東、陜西。

translations.literal: Wait until there are achievements, then extend next to Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until there are achievements, then extend next to Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 庶東南轉漕可減，西北儲蓄常充，國計永無絀矣。

translations.literal: Then southeast transport tribute can be reduced, northwest stores always filled, and state finances forever without deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Then southeast transport tribute can be reduced, northwest stores always filled, and state finances forever without deficit.

sentences.zh: 其議軍班則言：

translations.literal: His proposal on military households then said:
translations.idiomatic: His proposal on military households then said:

sentences.zh: 東南民素柔脆，莫任遠戍。

translations.literal: Southeastern people are by nature soft and fragile—they cannot bear distant garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern people are by nature soft and fragile—they cannot bear distant garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 今數千里勾軍，離其骨肉。

translations.literal: Now soldiers are levied from thousands of li, parted from flesh and blood.
translations.idiomatic: Now soldiers are levied from thousands of li, parted from flesh and blood.

sentences.zh: 而軍壯出於戶丁，幫解出於裏甲，每軍不下百金。
