translations.literal: Strong soldiers come from household sons; escort costs come from village tithing—each soldier costs no less than one hundred gold.
translations.idiomatic: Strong soldiers come from household sons; escort costs come from village tithing—each soldier costs no less than one hundred gold.

sentences.zh: 而軍非土著，誌不久安，輒賂衛官求歸。

translations.literal: Yet soldiers are not native to the place and do not long intend to settle—they promptly bribe guard officials to seek return.
translations.idiomatic: Yet soldiers are not native to the place and do not long intend to settle—they promptly bribe guard officials to seek return.

sentences.zh: 衛官利其賂，且可以冒餉也，因而縱之。

translations.literal: Guard officials profit from the bribes and can also falsely claim rations, and thus release them.
translations.idiomatic: Guard officials profit from the bribes and can also falsely claim rations, and thus release them.

sentences.zh: 是困東南之民，而實無補於軍政也。

translations.literal: This harms the people of the southeast yet truly adds nothing to military governance.
translations.idiomatic: This harms the people of the southeast yet truly adds nothing to military governance.

sentences.zh: 宜仿匠班例，軍戶應出軍者，歲征其錢，而召募土著以足之便。

translations.literal: One should follow the artisan-household precedent: military households that should supply soldiers yearly pay money, and native recruits are summoned to fill the quota—that is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: One should follow the artisan-household precedent: military households that should supply soldiers yearly pay money, and native recruits are summoned to fill the quota—that is convenient.

sentences.zh: 事皆下所司。

translations.literal: Both matters were referred to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Both matters were referred to the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書譚綸言勾軍之制不可廢。

translations.literal: Minister of War Tan Lun said the system of levying soldiers cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Tan Lun said the system of levying soldiers cannot be abolished.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書郭朝賓則以水田勞民，請俟異日。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Guo Chaobin then said paddy fields would weary the people and requested waiting for another day.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Guo Chaobin then said paddy fields would weary the people and requested waiting for another day.

sentences.zh: 事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was shelved.

sentences.zh: 及貞明被謫，至潞河，終以前議可行，乃著《潞水客談》以畢其說。

translations.literal: When Zhenming was demoted, at the Lu River he finally held the prior proposal feasible and therefore wrote the Traveler's Talk on the Lu River to complete his argument.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenming was demoted, at the Lu River he finally held the prior proposal feasible and therefore wrote the Traveler's Talk on the Lu River to complete his argument.

sentences.zh: 其略曰：

translations.literal: Its summary says:
translations.idiomatic: Its summary says:

sentences.zh: 西北之地，旱則赤地千里，潦則洪流萬頃，惟雨旸時若，庶樂歲無饑，此可常恃哉？

translations.literal: In the northwest when drought then a thousand li of bare earth, when flood then ten thousand qing of rushing water—only when rain and sunshine are timely can one hope for a good year without famine—can this be always relied on?
translations.idiomatic: In the northwest when drought then a thousand li of bare earth, when flood then ten thousand qing of rushing water—only when rain and sunshine are timely can one hope for a good year without famine—can this be always relied on?

sentences.zh: 惟水利興而後旱潦有備，利一。

translations.literal: Only when water works flourish are drought and flood provided against—benefit one.
translations.idiomatic: Only when water works flourish are drought and flood provided against—benefit one.

sentences.zh: 中人治生，必有常稔之田，以國家之全盛，獨待哺於東南，豈計之得哉？

translations.literal: A middling man managing livelihood must have fields of regular harvest—to have the realm in full strength depend solely on feeding from the southeast, is that a winning plan?
translations.idiomatic: A middling man managing livelihood must have fields of regular harvest—to have the realm in full strength depend solely on feeding from the southeast, is that a winning plan?

sentences.zh: 水利興則余糧棲畝皆倉庾之積，利二。

translations.literal: When water works flourish surplus grain in the fields is all granary accumulation—benefit two.
translations.idiomatic: When water works flourish surplus grain in the fields is all granary accumulation—benefit two.

sentences.zh: 東南轉輸，其費數倍。

translations.literal: Southeast transport costs several times over.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast transport costs several times over.

sentences.zh: 若西北有一石之入，則東南省數石之輸，久則蠲租之詔可下，東南民力庶幾稍蘇，利三。

translations.literal: If the northwest has one shi entering, the southeast saves several shi in transport; in time edicts remitting rent can be issued and southeastern people's strength may somewhat revive—benefit three.
translations.idiomatic: If the northwest has one shi entering, the southeast saves several shi in transport; in time edicts remitting rent can be issued and southeastern people's strength may somewhat revive—benefit three.

sentences.zh: 西北無溝洫，故河水橫流，而民居多沒。

translations.literal: The northwest has no ditches and canals, so river water runs wild and people's dwellings are mostly submerged.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest has no ditches and canals, so river water runs wild and people's dwellings are mostly submerged.

sentences.zh: 修復水田，則可分河流，殺水患，利四。

translations.literal: Restoring paddy fields can divide rivers and reduce water disaster—benefit four.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring paddy fields can divide rivers and reduce water disaster—benefit four.

sentences.zh: 西北地平曠，寇騎得以長驅。

translations.literal: The northwest is flat and open and bandit cavalry can charge at length.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest is flat and open and bandit cavalry can charge at length.

sentences.zh: 若溝洫盡舉，則田野皆金湯，利五。

translations.literal: If ditches and canals are fully established then fields are all impregnable fortresses—benefit five.
translations.idiomatic: If ditches and canals are fully established then fields are all impregnable fortresses—benefit five.

sentences.zh: 遊民輕去鄉土，易於為亂。

translations.literal: Vagrant people lightly leave native soil and easily become disorderly.
translations.idiomatic: Vagrant people lightly leave native soil and easily become disorderly.

sentences.zh: 水利興則業農者依田裏，而遊民有所歸，利六。

translations.literal: When water works flourish those who farm depend on fields and hamlets and vagrants have somewhere to return—benefit six.
translations.idiomatic: When water works flourish those who farm depend on fields and hamlets and vagrants have somewhere to return—benefit six.

sentences.zh: 招南人以耕西北之田，則民均而田亦均，利七。

translations.literal: Summoning southerners to farm northwest fields—then people are equal and fields are equal—benefit seven.
translations.idiomatic: Summoning southerners to farm northwest fields—then people are equal and fields are equal—benefit seven.

sentences.zh: 東南多漏役之民，西北罹重徭之苦，以南賦繁而役減，北賦省而徭重也。

translations.literal: The southeast has many who evade corvée; the northwest suffers heavy corvée—the south has heavy levies and light corvée, the north light levies and heavy corvée.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast has many who evade corvée; the northwest suffers heavy corvée—the south has heavy levies and light corvée, the north light levies and heavy corvée.

sentences.zh: 使田墾而民聚，則賦增而北徭可減，利八。

translations.literal: If fields are opened and people gather then levies increase and northern corvée can be reduced—benefit eight.
translations.idiomatic: If fields are opened and people gather then levies increase and northern corvée can be reduced—benefit eight.

sentences.zh: 沿邊諸鎮有積貯，轉輸不煩，利九。

translations.literal: Border garrisons have accumulated stores and relay transport is not troublesome—benefit nine.
translations.idiomatic: Border garrisons have accumulated stores and relay transport is not troublesome—benefit nine.

sentences.zh: 天下浮戶依富家為佃客者何限，募之為農而簡之為兵，屯政無不舉矣，利十。

translations.literal: How many floating households under great families as tenant laborers are there under heaven? Recruit them to farm and select them as soldiers—garrison policy is fully achieved—benefit ten.
translations.idiomatic: How many floating households under great families as tenant laborers are there under heaven? Recruit them to farm and select them as soldiers—garrison policy is fully achieved—benefit ten.

sentences.zh: 塞上之卒，土著者少。

translations.literal: Soldiers on the frontier are few natives.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers on the frontier are few natives.

sentences.zh: 屯政舉則兵自足，可以省遠募之費，蘇班戍之勞，停攝勾之苦，利十一。

translations.literal: When garrison policy is achieved troops suffice of themselves—distant recruitment expense can be saved, corvée garrison labor relieved, and substitute levy suffering stopped—benefit eleven.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison policy is achieved troops suffice of themselves—distant recruitment expense can be saved, corvée garrison labor relieved, and substitute levy suffering stopped—benefit eleven.

sentences.zh: 宗祿浩繁，勢將難繼。

translations.literal: Imperial clan stipends are vast and will be hard to continue.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clan stipends are vast and will be hard to continue.

sentences.zh: 今自中尉以下，量祿之田，使自食其土，為長子孫計，則宗祿可減，利十二。

translations.literal: Now from middle-rank princes downward, allot stipend fields so they eat their own soil and plan for long generations—then clan stipends can be reduced—benefit twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Now from middle-rank princes downward, allot stipend fields so they eat their own soil and plan for long generations—then clan stipends can be reduced—benefit twelve.

sentences.zh: 修復水利，則仿古井田，可限民名田。

translations.literal: Restoring water works then following ancient well-field systems one can limit people's named fields.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring water works then following ancient well-field systems one can limit people's named fields.

sentences.zh: 而自昔養民之政漸可舉行，利十三。

translations.literal: And policies nourishing the people of old can gradually be carried out—benefit thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: And policies nourishing the people of old can gradually be carried out—benefit thirteen.

sentences.zh: 民與地均，可仿古比閭族黨之制，而教化漸興，風俗自美，利十四也。

translations.literal: When people and land are equal one can follow ancient bi, lü, zu, and dang systems—and teaching gradually rises and customs naturally become fine—benefit fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: When people and land are equal one can follow ancient bi, lü, zu, and dang systems—and teaching gradually rises and customs naturally become fine—benefit fourteen.

sentences.zh: 譚綸見而美之曰：「我歷塞上久，知其必可行也。

translations.literal: Tan Lun read it and praised it, saying: "I have long been on the frontier and know it must be feasible.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Lun read it and praised it, saying, "I have long been on the frontier and know it must be feasible.

sentences.zh: 」已而順天巡撫張國彥、副使顧養謙行之薊州、永平、豐潤、玉田，皆有效。

translations.literal: " Later Shuntian grand coordinator Zhang Guoyan and vice commissioner Gu Yangqian carried it out in Jizhou, Yongping, Fengrun, and Yutian—all had effect.
translations.idiomatic: " Later Shuntian grand coordinator Zhang Guoyan and vice commissioner Gu Yangqian carried it out in Jizhou, Yongping, Fengrun, and Yutian—all had effect.

sentences.zh: 及是貞明還朝，御史蘇瓚、徐待力言其說可行，而給事中王敬民又特疏論薦，帝乃進貞明少卿，賜之敕，令往會撫按諸臣勘議。

translations.literal: At this time Zhenming returned to court; censors Su Zan and Xu Dai strongly said his plan was feasible, and supervising secretary Wang Jingmin also specially memorialized recommending him—the emperor then promoted Zhenming to vice director and granted him an edict ordering him to meet grand coordinators and other officials for inspection and deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zhenming returned to court; censors Su Zan and Xu Dai strongly said his plan was feasible, and supervising secretary Wang Jingmin also specially memorialized recommending him—the emperor then promoted Zhenming to vice director and granted him an edict ordering him to meet grand coordinators and other officials for inspection and deliberation.

sentences.zh: 時瓚方奉命巡關，復獻議曰：「治水與墾田相濟，未有水不治而田可墾者。

translations.literal: At the time Zan was just ordered to inspect the passes and again submitted a proposal, saying: "Managing water and opening fields assist each other—never is there land that can be opened without water first being managed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zan was just ordered to inspect the passes and again submitted a proposal, saying, "Managing water and opening fields assist each other—never is there land that can be opened without water first being managed.

sentences.zh: 畿輔為患之水莫如盧溝、滹沱二河。

translations.literal: In the capital region the waters causing disaster are none like the Lugou and Hutuo rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital region the waters causing disaster are none like the Lugou and Hutuo rivers.

sentences.zh: 盧溝發源於桑乾，滹沱發源於泰戲，源遠流長。

translations.literal: Lugou rises from Sanggan, Hutuo from Tai'xi—sources distant, flows long.
translations.idiomatic: Lugou rises from Sanggan, Hutuo from Tai'xi—sources distant, flows long.

sentences.zh: 又合深、易、濡、泡、沙、滋諸水，散入各澱，而泉渠溪港悉註其中。

translations.literal: They also join the Shen, Yi, Ru, Pao, Sha, and Zi waters, dispersing into various marshes, while springs, channels, streams, and harbors all pour into them.
translations.idiomatic: They also join the Shen, Yi, Ru, Pao, Sha, and Zi waters, dispersing into various marshes, while springs, channels, streams, and harbors all pour into them.

sentences.zh: 以故高橋、白洋諸澱，大者廣圍一二百里，小亦四五十里。

translations.literal: Hence Gaojiao, Baiyang, and other marshes—the large ones a hundred or two hundred li in circumference, the small forty or fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Gaojiao, Baiyang, and other marshes—the large ones a hundred or two hundred li in circumference, the small forty or fifty li.

sentences.zh: 每當夏秋淫潦，膏腴變為瀉鹵，菽麥化為萑葦，甚可惜也。

translations.literal: Whenever summer and autumn bring excessive rain, fertile land turns to saline flats and beans and wheat become reeds and rushes—deeply regrettable.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever summer and autumn bring excessive rain, fertile land turns to saline flats and beans and wheat become reeds and rushes—deeply regrettable.

sentences.zh: 今治水之策有三：浚河以決水之壅，疏渠以殺澱之勢，撤曲防以均民之利而已。

translations.literal: Now the policies for managing water are three: dredge rivers to release blocked water, clear channels to reduce marsh force, and remove curved dikes to equalize people's benefit—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Now the policies for managing water are three: dredge rivers to release blocked water, clear channels to reduce marsh force, and remove curved dikes to equalize people's benefit—that is all.

sentences.zh: 」帝並下貞明。

translations.literal: " The emperor also referred both to Zhenming.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor also referred both to Zhenming.

sentences.zh: 貞明乃躬歷京東州縣，相原隰，度土宜，周覽水泉分合，條列事宜以上。

translations.literal: Zhenming then personally traveled the eastern capital prefectures and counties, surveyed high and low ground, measured soil suitability, and thoroughly viewed the joining and parting of springs and waters, listing matters in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming then personally traveled the eastern capital prefectures and counties, surveyed high and low ground, measured soil suitability, and thoroughly viewed the joining and parting of springs and waters, listing matters in memorial.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書畢鏘等力贊之，因采貞明疏，議為六事：請郡縣有司以墾田勤惰為殿最，聽貞明舉劾；

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Bi Feng and others strongly supported it; adopting Zhenming's memorial they deliberated six measures: request that prefectural and county officials take diligence in opening fields as basis for merit review, and permit Zhenming to recommend and impeach;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Bi Feng and others strongly supported it; adopting Zhenming's memorial they deliberated six measures: request that prefectural and county officials take diligence in opening fields as basis for merit review, and permit Zhenming to recommend and impeach;

sentences.zh: 地宜稻者以漸勸率，宜黍宜粟者如故，不遽責其成；

translations.literal: where land suits rice gradually encourage it; where it suits millet or sorghum leave as before—not immediately demanding completion;
translations.idiomatic: where land suits rice gradually encourage it; where it suits millet or sorghum leave as before—not immediately demanding completion;

sentences.zh: 召募南人，給衣食農具，俾以一教十；

translations.literal: summon southerners, provide food, clothing, and farm tools, and have one teach ten;
translations.idiomatic: summon southerners, provide food, clothing, and farm tools, and have one teach ten;

sentences.zh: 能墾田百畝以上，即為世業，子弟得寄籍入學，其卓有明效者，仿古孝弟力田科，量授鄉遂都鄙之長；

translations.literal: those who can open more than one hundred mu of fields make it hereditary estate and sons and brothers may register for school elsewhere; those with outstanding clear effect follow the ancient Filial Piety and Diligent Farming subject and are measured out as heads of districts and hamlets;
translations.idiomatic: those who can open more than one hundred mu of fields make it hereditary estate and sons and brothers may register for school elsewhere; those with outstanding clear effect follow the ancient Filial Piety and Diligent Farming subject and are measured out as heads of districts and hamlets;

sentences.zh: 墾荒無力者，貸以谷，秋成還官，旱潦則免；

translations.literal: those without strength to open wasteland are loaned grain, repaid at autumn harvest, exempt in drought and flood;
translations.idiomatic: those without strength to open wasteland are loaned grain, repaid at autumn harvest, exempt in drought and flood;

sentences.zh: 郡縣民壯，役止三月，使疏河芟草，而墾田則募專工。

translations.literal: able-bodied men of prefectures and counties serve corvée only three months, making them dredge rivers and cut grass, while field opening employs specialized labor.
translations.idiomatic: able-bodied men of prefectures and counties serve corvée only three months, making them dredge rivers and cut grass, while field opening employs specialized labor.

sentences.zh: 帝悉從之。

translations.literal: The emperor fully approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fully approved.

sentences.zh: 其年九月，遂命貞明兼監察御史領墾田使，有司撓者劾治。

translations.literal: That year in the ninth month he was ordered Zhenming concurrently as investigating censor leading the field-opening commissioner; officials who obstructed were impeached and punished.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the ninth month he was ordered Zhenming concurrently as investigating censor leading the field-opening commissioner; officials who obstructed were impeached and punished.

sentences.zh: 貞明先詣永平，募南人為倡。

translations.literal: Zhenming first went to Yongping and recruited southerners as pioneers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming first went to Yongping and recruited southerners as pioneers.

sentences.zh: 至明年二月，已墾至三萬九千余畝。

translations.literal: By the second month of the next year fields opened reached more than thirty-nine thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: By the second month of the next year fields opened reached more than thirty-nine thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 又遍歷諸河，窮源竟委，將大行疏浚。

translations.literal: He also traveled all the rivers, tracing sources to ends, and was about to carry out large-scale dredging.
translations.idiomatic: He also traveled all the rivers, tracing sources to ends, and was about to carry out large-scale dredging.

sentences.zh: 而奄人、勛戚之占閑田為業者，恐水田興而己失其利也，爭言不便，為蜚語聞於帝。

translations.literal: But eunuchs and imperial kinsmen who held idle land as livelihood feared that if paddy fields flourished they would lose their profit and competed to say it was inconvenient, spreading slander to reach the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: But eunuchs and imperial kinsmen who held idle land as livelihood feared that if paddy fields flourished they would lose their profit and competed to say it was inconvenient, spreading slander to reach the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝惑之。

translations.literal: The emperor was perplexed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was perplexed.

sentences.zh: 三月，閣臣申時行等以風霾陳時政，力言其利。

translations.literal: In the third month Grand Secretaries Shen Shixing and others, citing sandstorms, set forth current policy and strongly spoke of the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Grand Secretaries Shen Shixing and others, citing sandstorms, set forth current policy and strongly spoke of the benefit.

sentences.zh: 帝意終不釋。

translations.literal: The emperor's mind was still not released.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's mind was still not released.

sentences.zh: 御史王之棟，畿輔人也，遂言水田必不可行，且陳開滹沱不便者十二。

translations.literal: Censor Wang Zhidong, a man of the capital region, then said paddy fields absolutely could not be carried out and also set forth twelve inconveniences of opening the Hutuo.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wang Zhidong, a man of the capital region, then said paddy fields absolutely could not be carried out and also set forth twelve inconveniences of opening the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 帝乃召見時行等，諭令停役。

translations.literal: The emperor then summoned Shen Shixing and others and ordered labor stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then summoned Shen Shixing and others and ordered labor stopped.

sentences.zh: 時行等請罷開河，專事墾田。

translations.literal: Shen Shixing and others requested abandoning river opening and devoting effort solely to field opening.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Shixing and others requested abandoning river opening and devoting effort solely to field opening.

sentences.zh: 已，工部議之棟疏，亦如閣臣言。

translations.literal: Then the Ministry of Works deliberated Zhidong's memorial, also like the grand secretaries' words.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Ministry of Works deliberated Zhidong's memorial, also like the grand secretaries' words.

sentences.zh: 帝卒罷之，而欲追罪建議者，用閣臣言而止。

translations.literal: The emperor finally stopped it and wished to pursue guilt against those who proposed it; by grand secretaries' words he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor finally stopped it and wished to pursue guilt against those who proposed it; by grand secretaries' words he stopped.

sentences.zh: 貞明乃還故官。

translations.literal: Zhenming then returned to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming then returned to his former post.

sentences.zh: 尋乞假歸。

translations.literal: Soon he asked leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he asked leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 十八年卒。

translations.literal: In year 18 he died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he died.

sentences.zh: 貞明識敏才練，慨然有經世誌。

translations.literal: Zhenming was perceptive and skilled, with expansive will to order the age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenming was perceptive and skilled, with expansive will to order the age.

sentences.zh: 京東水田實百世利，事初興而即為浮議所撓，論者惜之。

translations.literal: Eastern capital paddy fields were truly benefit for a hundred generations; the matter had just begun when empty talk obstructed it—commentators regret it.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern capital paddy fields were truly benefit for a hundred generations; the matter had just begun when empty talk obstructed it—commentators regret it.

sentences.zh: 初議時，吳人伍袁萃謂貞明曰：「民可使由，不可使知。

translations.literal: At the initial deliberation Wu man Wu Yuancui said to Zhenming: "The people may be made to follow but not to know.
translations.idiomatic: At the initial deliberation Wu man Wu Yuancui said to Zhenming, "The people may be made to follow but not to know.

sentences.zh: 君所言，得無太盡耶？

translations.literal: What you say—would it not be too complete?
translations.idiomatic: What you say—would it not be too complete?

sentences.zh: 」貞明問故。

translations.literal: " Zhenming asked why.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhenming asked why.

sentences.zh: 袁萃曰：「北人懼東南漕儲派於西北，煩言必起矣。

translations.literal: Yuancui said: "Northerners fear southeast transport stores will be apportioned to the northwest—troublesome talk will surely arise.
translations.idiomatic: Yuancui said, "Northerners fear southeast transport stores will be apportioned to the northwest—troublesome talk will surely arise.

sentences.zh: 」貞明默然。

translations.literal: " Zhenming was silent.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhenming was silent.

sentences.zh: 已而之棟竟劾奏如袁萃言。

translations.literal: Before long Zhidong indeed impeached and memorialized just as Yuancui had said.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhidong indeed impeached and memorialized just as Yuancui had said.

sentences.zh: 袁萃，字聖起，吳縣人。

translations.literal: Yuancui, styled Shengqi, was a man of Wu County.
translations.idiomatic: Yuancui, styled Shengqi, was a native of Wu County.

sentences.zh: 舉萬歷五年會試。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fifth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fifth year of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 又三年釋褐，授貴溪知縣。

translations.literal: Three years later he entered office and was appointed magistrate of Guixi.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later he entered office and was appointed magistrate of Guixi.

sentences.zh: 擢兵部主事，進員外郎，署職方事。

translations.literal: Promoted to principal officer in the Ministry of War, advanced to vice director, acting in the Bureau of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to principal officer in the Ministry of War, advanced to vice director, acting in the Bureau of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 李成梁子如楨求為錦衣大帥，袁萃力爭，寢之。

translations.literal: Li Chengliang's son Ruzhen sought to be grand commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard; Yuancui forcefully contended and the matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengliang's son Ruzhen sought to be grand commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard; Yuancui forcefully contended and the matter was shelved.

sentences.zh: 出為浙江提學僉事。

translations.literal: He went out as educational intendant of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as educational intendant of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 巡撫牒數十人寄學，立卻還之。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator's dispatch placed dozens of people in registered study; he immediately refused and returned them.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator's dispatch placed dozens of people in registered study; he immediately refused and returned them.

sentences.zh: 歷廣東海北道副使。

translations.literal: He served as vice commissioner of the Haibei circuit in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice commissioner of the Haibei circuit in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 中官李敬轄珠池，其參隨擅殺人，袁萃捕論如法。

translations.literal: Eunuch Li Jing oversaw the pearl pool; his attendants arbitrarily killed people and Yuancui arrested and tried them according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Li Jing oversaw the pearl pool; his attendants arbitrarily killed people and Yuancui arrested and tried them according to law.

sentences.zh: 請告歸。

translations.literal: He requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: He requested leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 所撰《林居漫錄》、《彈園雜志》多貶斥當世公卿大夫，而於李三才、於玉立尤甚雲。

translations.literal: His works Forest Dwelling Miscellany and Bullet Garden Miscellany mostly disparage the great ministers of the age, and toward Li Sancai and Yu Yuli he was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: His works Forest Dwelling Miscellany and Bullet Garden Miscellany mostly disparage the great ministers of the age, and toward Li Sancai and Yu Yuli he was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：事功之難立也，始則群疑朋興，繼而忌口交鑠，此勞臣任事者所為腐心也。

translations.literal: The commentators say: How hard it is to establish achievement! At first many doubts rise together; afterward mouths that eat cross and burn—this is what laboring ministers undertaking tasks agonize over.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: How hard it is to establish achievement! At first many doubts rise together; afterward mouths that eat cross and burn—this is what laboring ministers undertaking tasks agonize over.

sentences.zh: 盛應期諸人治漕營田，所規畫為軍國久遠大計，其奏效或在數十年後。

translations.literal: Sheng Yingqi and the others in managing grain transport and planning fields laid out long-term plans for army and state; their effect might come decades later.
